D2-001.q: Aap storage account firewall enable karte hain aur VNet1/SubnetA add karte hain. SubnetA ki VMs ab bhi storage account tak nahi pohanch patin. Sab se mumkin missing step kya hai?
opts: SubnetA par inbound port 445 allow karne wala NSG rule
D2-001.exp: VNet subnet ka storage firewall rule tabhi kaam karta hai jab us subnet par Microsoft.Storage service endpoint ho, taa ke traffic subnet ki identity ke sath pohanche. Is ke baghair VMs ka traffic public IP se aata hai aur block ho jata hai. Private endpoint alag tareeqa hai, port 445 sirf SMB ke liye hai, aur public IPs ki zaroorat nahi.

D2-002.q: Storage firewall 'selected networks' ke sath enable karne ke baad Azure Backup aur kuch Microsoft services kaam karna band kar deti hain. Kaun si setting account ko internet par khole baghair yeh theek karti hai?
opts: Allow trusted Microsoft services to access this storage account
IP rules mein 0.0.0.0/0 add karein aur secure transfer lazmi karein
D2-002.exp: 'Allow trusted Microsoft services to access this storage account' storage firewall mein ek exception hai. Jab sirf selected networks allowed hon tab bhi Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery aur Azure Monitor jaisi services account tak pohanch sakti hain. 0.0.0.0/0 add karna ya firewall band karna account ko poore internet ke liye khol dega, aur anonymous access baghair authentication ke reads ke bare mein hai, network rules ke bare mein nahi.

D2-003.q: Firewall enabled hone ke dauran aap apne office (public IP 203.0.113.10) se storage account administer karte hain. Aap kya add karenge?
opts: Aap ke office ke liye Microsoft.Storage service endpoint wala VNet rule
Firewall ke IP address rules mein office ka public IP (ya range)
D2-003.exp: Storage firewall ke do qisam ke rules hain: public internet addresses aur ranges ke liye IP rules, aur Azure subnets ke liye virtual network rules. Aap ka office apne public IP se Azure tak pohanchta hai, is liye 203.0.113.10 ko IP rule ke taur par add karein. VNet rule sirf Azure subnets ke liye kaam karta hai, private endpoint Azure VNet mein hota hai, aur NSG rules storage account ka access control nahi karte.

D2-004.q: SAS ke kaun se fields token ko sirf ek di gayi IP range se aur sirf HTTPS par kaam karne tak mehdood karte hain?
D2-004.exp: SAS token mein sip (signed IP — allowed address ya range) aur spr (signed protocol — https, ya https,http) ho sakte hain. sip aur spr=https ke sath token sirf us range se aur sirf HTTPS par kaam karta hai. 'Signed services' blob, file, queue ya table chunta hai; policy ka naam aur access tier callers ko mehdood nahi karte.

D2-005.q: Aap ne 1 saal ke liye valid ad-hoc service SAS tokens jari kiye. Ek token leak ho gaya. Usay revoke kaise karenge?
opts: Usay sign karne wali account key regenerate karein
User ko Entra ID se hata dein
Blob tier Archive par set karein
D2-005.exp: Ad-hoc SAS ko akele revoke nahi kiya ja sakta; signing key regenerate karne se woh khatam hota hai (aur us key se sign hue baqi sab bhi). Is se bachne ke liye stored access policies use karein.

D2-006.q: Stored access policy se SAS tokens banane ka asal faida kya hai?
opts: Aap baad mein policy badal ya revoke kar sakte hain, jis ka asar us se jure tamam SAS par foran hota hai
Tokens signature ke baghair kaam karte hain
Tokens storage firewall bypass karte hain, is liye partners ko apne IP rule ya private endpoint ki zaroorat nahi
D2-006.exp: Stored access policy se jura SAS apna start time, expiry aur permissions policy se leta hai. Policy badlein ya delete karein, aur us ko use karne wala har SAS foran update ya revoke ho jata hai, account keys rotate kiye baghair. Policy-based SAS phir bhi expire hote hain, signature mangte hain, aur firewall maante hain.

D2-007.q: Har container par kitni stored access policies define ho sakti hain?
D2-007.exp: Har container, file share, queue ya table mein zyada se zyada 5 stored access policies ho sakti hain. Policy se jure SAS tokens revoke karne ke liye aap woh policy badalte ya delete karte hain, is liye paanch slots soch samajh kar plan karein, maslan har partner ya maqsad ke liye ek.

D2-008.q: Kaun sa SAS type storage account key ke bajaye Microsoft Entra credentials se sign hota hai?
D2-008.exp: User delegation SAS us user delegation key se sign hota hai jo aap Microsoft Entra credentials se mangte hain, account key se nahi. Isi liye Microsoft isay recommend karta hai: koi account key shamil nahi, aur access RBAC permissions wali identity se jura hota hai. Account aur service SAS dono account key se sign hote hain.

D2-009.q: Mojooda Microsoft Learn documentation ke mutabiq kaun si services user delegation SAS support karti hain?
opts: Blob (Data Lake samet), Queue, Table aur Azure Files
Sirf Queue aur Table, jab account general-purpose v2 ho
D2-009.exp: User delegation SAS Blob storage (Data Lake samet), Queue, Table aur Azure Files ke liye supported hai. Purana study material sirf Blob kehta hai, kyun ke doosri services ka support baad mein add hua.

D2-010.q: Storage account ki kitni access keys hoti hain, aur kyun?
opts: 2, taa ke ek key rotate karte waqt clients doosri use karein
3, taa ke primary, secondary aur tertiary region ki apni apni key ho
D2-010.exp: Har storage account ki do access keys (key1 aur key2) hoti hain taa ke aap baghair downtime ke unhein rotate kar sakein: applications ko key2 par le jayen, key1 regenerate karein, unhein nayi key1 par wapas layen, phir key2 regenerate karein. Sirf ek key hoti to usay regenerate karte hi har client foran toot jata.

D2-011.q: Kaun si service applications ke liye storage keys mehfooz tareeqe se rakhti hai aur rotation automate karne mein madad kar sakti hai?
D2-011.exp: Azure Key Vault storage account keys jaise secrets mehfooz tareeqe se rakhta hai aur un ki rotation manage kar sakta hai. Storage account par key expiration policy aap ko yaad dilati hai jab keys rotate karne ka waqt ho. Advisor, Monitor aur Network Watcher secrets store nahi karte.

D2-012.q: Azure file share ke users ko SMB par apni on-premises AD DS identities se authenticate karna hai. Account par AD DS authentication enable karne ke ilawa users ko files tak access ke liye kya configure karna hoga?
opts: Share-level RBAC permissions AUR files aur directories par NTFS permissions
Har user ke liye SAS token AUR share ki root directory par anonymous read access
D2-012.exp: Azure Files ke identity-based access ki do tehain hain, aur user ko dono chahiye. Share-level permission share par Azure RBAC role hai, jaise Storage File Data SMB Share Contributor. File aur folder level permission Windows NTFS ACLs hain, jo files kholte waqt check hoti hain. SAS tokens se SMB shares mount nahi hote, aur Azure Files mein anonymous access supported nahi.

D2-013.q: Azure Files SMB identity-based authentication ke liye kaun se TEEN identity sources supported hain?
D2-013.exp: Azure Files SMB ke liye teen identity sources support karta hai: on-premises AD DS (account aap ke domain se joined hota hai), Microsoft Entra Domain Services (Azure mein managed domain), aur Microsoft Entra Kerberos (hybrid identities ke liye, domain controllers tak pohanch ke baghair). Google identities aur local Windows accounts use nahi ho sakte.

D2-014.q: Kaun sa built-in role account management rights diye baghair Entra ID authentication se blob data parhne deta hai?
D2-014.exp: Storage Blob Data Reader data-plane role hai: yeh Microsoft Entra authentication se containers aur blobs parhne deta hai, aur kuch nahi. Reader aur Storage Account Contributor control-plane roles hain: yeh account ki settings cover karte hain, data nahi. Contributor account manage karta hai aur data sirf access keys le kar parh sakta hai.

D2-015.q: Storage account par Reader role wala user portal mein 'Microsoft Entra user account' authentication se blobs browse karta hai. Kya hota hai?
opts: Poora blob read access, kyunke Reader mein har read data action shamil hai
Blob data ka access deny hota hai, kyun ke Reader control-plane role hai
D2-015.exp: Reader control-plane role hai: yeh storage account aur us ki settings dekh sakta hai lekin data parhne ki koi permission nahi deta. Jab portal 'Microsoft Entra user account' authentication use karta hai to blobs parhne ke liye Storage Blob Data Reader jaisa data role chahiye, is liye access deny hota hai. (Access-key mode mein bhi fail hota, kyun ke Reader keys list nahi kar sakta.)

D2-016.q: Internet par koi bhi URL se blobs parh sake lekin container list na kar sake, is ke liye container ka anonymous access level kya set karein?
D2-016.exp: 'Blob' anonymous access level har kisi ko blob parhne deta hai agar woh us ka URL jaanta ho, lekin woh container ke contents list nahi kar sakta. 'Container' parhna aur list karna dono allow karta hai. 'Private' koi anonymous access nahi deta, aur 'Public-All' mojood nahi. Anonymous access account level par bhi allowed hona chahiye.

D2-017.q: Har statement ka jawab Haan ya Nahi mein dein:
stmts: Account key regenerate karne se us se sign hua har SAS invalid ho jata hai
SAS apni referenced stored access policy se zyada permissions de sakta hai
Jab tak exceptions configure na hon, storage firewall Azure services samet tamam networks par apply hota hai
Blob aur Queue data operations ke liye Entra ID authentication supported hai
D2-017.exp: Account key regenerate karne se us key se sign hua har SAS invalid ho jata hai. SAS apni referenced stored access policy se zyada nahi de sakta. Jab tak aap exceptions add na karein, storage firewall Azure services samet tamam networks block karta hai. Aur Blob aur Queue data operations ke liye Entra ID authentication kaam karti hai.

D2-018.q: Aam scenarios ke liye jin mein blobs, files, queues aur tables tamam redundancy options ke sath chahiye, kaun sa storage account type banana chahiye?
D2-018.exp: General-purpose v2 (GPv2) blobs, files, queues aur tables, hot, cool, cold aur archive tiers, aur har redundancy option (LRS, ZRS, GRS, RA-GRS, GZRS, RA-GZRS) support karta hai. Yeh Microsoft ka recommended default hai. Premium accounts har ek sirf ek service aur kam redundancy options support karte hain, aur BlobStorage purani qisam hai.

D2-019.q: Database workload ke SMB file share ke liye aap ko sab se kam latency chahiye. Kaun sa account kind?
opts: Hot tier ke sath Standard GPv2
D2-019.exp: Premium file shares FileStorage accounts par chalte hain, jo kam latency aur zyada IOPS ke liye SSDs use karte hain — jo SMB par database workloads ko chahiye. Standard GPv2 shares HDD-based storage use karte hain. BlockBlobStorage blobs ke liye premium hai, file shares ke liye nahi, aur GPv1 purani qisam hai.

D2-020.q: Kaun sa redundancy option data ki teen copies sirf ek datacenter ke andar rakhta hai?
D2-020.exp: Locally redundant storage (LRS) ek region ke ek datacenter ke andar teen synchronous copies rakhta hai. Yeh disk ya rack failures se bachata hai lekin poora datacenter khone se nahi. ZRS copies ko zones mein phailata hai, aur GRS aur GZRS data doosre region mein bhi copy karte hain.

D2-021.q: Data ko poore region ke outage se bachna chahiye AUR app ko kisi bhi waqt secondary region se parhna chahiye. Kam se kam redundancy?
D2-021.exp: GRS aur RA-GRS dono data ko asynchronously paired region mein copy karte hain, is liye woh region outage se bach jata hai. Sirf read-access wale versions (RA-GRS aur RA-GZRS) applications ko -secondary endpoint se kisi bhi waqt secondary copy parhne dete hain. Saade GRS mein secondary sirf failover ke baad parhi ja sakti hai. LRS aur ZRS ek region mein rehte hain.

D2-022.q: Kaun sa redundancy option primary region mein teen availability zones mein synchronously AUR secondary region mein asynchronously replicate karta hai?
D2-022.exp: Geo-zone-redundant storage (GZRS) primary region mein availability zones mein teen copies rakhta hai (ZRS ki tarah) aur data asynchronously secondary region mein bhi copy karta hai (GRS ki tarah). ZRS ek region mein rehta hai, GRS primary region mein sirf ek datacenter use karta hai, aur RA-LRS mojood nahi.

D2-023.q: GRS account par primary region ke lambe outage ke dauran failover kaun shuru kar sakta hai, aur us ke baad redundancy kya hoti hai?
opts: Sirf Microsoft isay shuru kar sakta hai; account GRS hi rehta hai aur regions aapas mein badal jate hain
Customer shuru kar sakta hai; naye primary region mein account LRS ban jata hai
1 ghante baad khud ho jata hai; ZRS
D2-023.exp: Customer-managed failover mein aap Microsoft ka intezar kiye baghair khud failover shuru kar sakte hain. Unplanned failover ke baad purana secondary primary ban jata hai aur wahan account LRS hota hai. Phir aap usay dobara mehfooz karne ke liye geo-redundancy reconfigure karte hain.

D2-024.q: Premium (block blob / file) storage account kaun se redundancy options use kar sakta hai?
D2-024.exp: Premium storage accounts (block blob aur file shares) sirf LRS aur, jin regions mein mile, ZRS support karte hain. In mein GRS ya RA-GRS jaise geo-redundant options nahi, is liye region outage se bachne ke liye aap ko doosra tareeqa chahiye, jaise object replication ya data ko standard account mein copy karna.

D2-025.q: Do storage accounts ke darmiyan object replication ke liye kya prerequisites hain?
opts: Source aur destination par blob versioning, aur source par change feed
Source aur destination par blob soft delete, aur ek lifecycle rule
Dono accounts ek hi region mein
D2-025.exp: Object replication blob version history aur change log se kaam karta hai. Source aur destination dono accounts par blob versioning on honi chahiye, aur source par change feed enabled hona chahiye. Accounts alag regions ya subscriptions mein ho sakte hain, aur soft delete zaroori nahi.

D2-026.q: Kaun si baat object replication ko behtareen tarah bayan karti hai?
opts: Ek hi Azure region ke andar tamam blob types ki synchronous copy, page aur append blobs samet
Accounts ke darmiyan block blobs ki asynchronous copy, jo alag regions ya subscriptions mein ho sakte hain
Sirf ek account ke andar kaam karta hai
D2-026.exp: Object replication block blobs ko ek account ke container se doosre account ke container mein asynchronously copy karta hai. Accounts alag regions, subscriptions ya tenants mein bhi ho sakte hain. Yeh synchronous nahi, page ya append blobs support nahi karta, aur archived blobs replicate nahi hote.

D2-027.q: Azure Storage ki service-side encryption at rest kaisi hai?
opts: Hamesha enabled aur disable nahi ho sakti
Har container par enable hoti hai
D2-027.exp: Azure Storage data at rest ko hamesha 256-bit AES (server-side encryption) se encrypt karta hai. Yeh har account mein default mein on hai aur band nahi ho sakti. Aap chun sakte hain ke key kaun manage kare — Microsoft ya aap (customer-managed keys) — lekin yeh nahi ke data encrypt ho ya nahi.

D2-028.q: Storage account ke liye customer-managed keys use karne ke liye key vault par kaun si do protections enabled honi chahiye?
D2-028.exp: Jab storage account customer-managed key use kare to woh key khone se data hamesha ke liye parhne ke qabil nahi rehta. Is liye Azure ko key vault par soft delete aur purge protection enabled chahiye, taa ke delete hui key wapas aa sake aur foran purge na ho. Firewalls, tags aur HSMs optional hain.

D2-029.q: Storage account ke liye infrastructure (double) encryption kab enable ho sakti hai?
opts: Encryption blade mein kisi bhi waqt
D2-029.exp: Infrastructure encryption alag key ke sath infrastructure level par encryption ki doosri teh add karti hai. Yeh sirf storage account banate waqt chuni ja sakti hai aur baad mein on nahi ho sakti; is ke liye naya account banayen aur data move karein.

D2-030.q: Kaun si AzCopy command C:\data ko container mein upload karti hai aur sirf woh files copy karti hai jo pichli baar ke baad badli hon?
D2-030.exp: azcopy sync source aur destination ka (last-modified time se) muqabla karti hai aur sirf nayi ya badli hui files copy karti hai, is liye baar baar chalane par sirf farq transfer hota hai. azcopy copy jo kuch aap dein sab copy karti hai, azcopy move incremental sync ke liye nahi, aur benchmark sirf performance test karta hai.

D2-031.q: AzCopy Blob storage se kis tarah authenticate kar sakta hai?
opts: Entra ID (azcopy login) ya SAS tokens
Account ka naam aur SSH key pair
D2-031.exp: AzCopy Microsoft Entra ID (azcopy login, jo managed identities aur service principals bhi support karta hai — aap ko Storage Blob Data Contributor jaisa data role chahiye) se ya URL ke sath lagaye gaye SAS token se authenticate kar sakta hai. Yeh SSH keys ya sirf account ka naam use nahi karta.

D2-032.q: Azure Storage Explorer ko behtareen tarah kaise bayan karenge?
opts: Sirf web par chalne wala monitoring dashboard jo storage capacity, latency aur availability dikhata hai
Blobs, files, queues, tables aur Data Lake manage karne ki muft cross-platform desktop app
D2-032.exp: Azure Storage Explorer Windows, macOS aur Linux ke liye muft desktop app hai. Aap kai accounts aur subscriptions mein blobs, files, queues, tables aur Data Lake storage browse aur manage kar sakte hain, data upload aur download kar sakte hain, aur SAS aur access policies manage kar sakte hain. Yeh web dashboard ya PowerShell module nahi.

D2-033.q: Aap ko bohat kam bandwidth wali jagah se 60 TB data Azure par copy karna hai. Amli option kya hai?
opts: Weekend par parallel uploads ke sath AzCopy
Azure Import/Export ya Azure Data Box
D2-033.exp: Bohat slow link par 60 TB mein hafte ya mahine lag sakte hain. Azure Data Box (ya apni disks ke sath Import/Export service) offline transfer hai: aap data site par device mein copy karte hain aur usay Azure datacenter bhejte hain, jahan woh upload hota hai. AzCopy, Storage Explorer aur RDP copies sab network par depend karti hain.

D2-034.q: Har statement ka jawab Haan ya Nahi mein dein:
stmts: Storage account ka naam globally unique, 3–24 characters, sirf lowercase letters aur numbers hona chahiye
Standard GPv2 account ko dobara banaye baghair LRS se GRS kiya ja sakta hai
Storage account ko doosre resource group mein move kiya ja sakta hai
Account ka default access tier Azure file shares par apply hota hai
D2-034.exp: Storage account ke naam globally unique, 3–24 characters, sirf lowercase letters aur numbers hone chahiye. Standard GPv2 account ko usi jagah LRS se GRS kiya ja sakta hai, aur account doosre resource group mein move ho sakta hai. Default access tier sirf blobs par apply hota hai, Azure file shares par nahi, jin ke apne tiers hain.

D2-035.q: Azure Files SMB shares kaun sa port use karte hain, jo bohat se ISPs block karte hain?
D2-035.exp: SMB TCP port 445 use karta hai. Bohat se ISPs aur ghar ke routers security ki wajah se outbound 445 block karte hain, is liye ghar se seedha Azure file share mount karna aksar 'System error 53' ke sath fail hota hai. HTTP 80, HTTPS 443 aur RDP 3389 use karta hai.

D2-036.q: On-premises users SMB file share tak nahi pohanch pate kyun ke ISP port 445 block karta hai. Amli hal kya hai?
opts: VPN/ExpressRoute (ya Azure File Sync) use karein taa ke SMB seedha internet par na jaye
Account ko RA-GRS par switch karein taa ke users secondary region se share mount karein
D2-036.exp: Agar ISP TCP 445 block kare to SMB traffic site-to-site VPN ya ExpressRoute se bhejein (aam tor par private endpoint tak), taa ke woh kabhi seedha internet par na jaye. Doosra tareeqa: Azure File Sync share ko local Windows Server par cache karta hai jahan users LAN se pohanchte hain. SMB ke liye HTTP ya port 80 mumkin nahi, aur redundancy settings connectivity par asar nahi dalti.

D2-037.q: Kaun sa file share protocol sirf premium (FileStorage) accounts par milta hai aur Linux se use hota hai?
D2-037.exp: NFS 4.1 file shares sirf premium FileStorage accounts par milte hain aur zyada tar Linux clients se mount hote hain. SMB 3.1.1 standard aur premium dono accounts par chalta hai. Azure Files FTP ya WebDAV offer nahi karta.

D2-038.q: Azure File Sync components ki sahi hierarchy kya hai?
opts: Storage Sync Service → sync group → ek cloud endpoint + server endpoints
Storage Sync Service → server endpoint → har group mein kai cloud endpoints
D2-038.exp: Azure File Sync ek Storage Sync Service hai jis mein sync groups hote hain. Har sync group mein bilkul ek cloud endpoint (Azure file share) aur ek ya zyada server endpoints (registered Windows Servers par folders) hote hain. Recovery Services vault is ka hissa nahi.

D2-039.q: Azure File Sync mein cloud tiering kya karti hai?
opts: Blobs ko archive tier mein le jati hai
Aksar use hone wali files local server par rakhti hai jab ke kam use hone wali files pointers ban jati hain, aur poori copies Azure mein hoti hain
Files ko locally compress karti hai
Do local servers ke darmiyan tamam files poori replicate karta hai, jab ke Azure sirf un ka metadata rakhta hai
D2-039.exp: Cloud tiering aksar use hone wali files local server par rakhti hai aur kam use hone wali files ko chhote pointers (reparse points) se badal deti hai, jab ke poori copies Azure file share mein rehti hain. Jab koi tiered file kholta hai to woh zaroorat par download hoti hai. Yeh files compress nahi karti, blob tiers nahi badalti, ya servers ko seedha ek doosre se sync nahi karti.

D2-040.q: Virtual machine disks (VHDs) ke liye kaun sa blob type use hota hai?
D2-040.exp: Page blobs 512-byte pages se bane hote hain aur tez random reads aur writes support karte hain, jaise VM disks (VHDs) kaam karti hain. Block blobs poori upload hone wali files aur objects ke liye hain, aur append blobs sirf aakhir mein barhne wale logs ke liye. 'Table blob' koi cheez nahi.

D2-041.q: Kaun sa access tier offline hai, yani rehydrate hone tak blob parha nahi ja sakta?
D2-041.exp: Archive wahid offline tier hai. Archived blob ko jab tak hot, cool ya cold mein rehydrate na karein aap usay parh ya badal nahi sakte, aur is mein 15 ghante tak lag sakte hain. Hot, cool aur cold online tiers hain jin mein milliseconds mein access milta hai.

D2-042.q: Standard priority se archived blob rehydrate karne mein aam tor par kitna waqt lagta hai?
D2-042.exp: Archived blobs offline hote hain aur parhne se pehle rehydrate karne parte hain. Standard priority mein 15 ghante tak lag sakte hain. High priority tez hai — 10 GB se chhote blobs ke liye aksar ek ghante se kam — lekin mehngi hai.

D2-043.q: Cool, cold aur archive tiers ke early-deletion periods kya hain?
D2-043.exp: Har thande tier ka kam se kam storage period hai: cool ke liye 30 din, cold ke liye 90 din aur archive ke liye 180 din. Agar aap blob ko pehle delete, overwrite ya bahar move karein to baqi period ka charge (prorated) lagta hai. Hot ka koi minimum nahi.

D2-044.q: Kaun se tiers account-level default access tier set ho sakte hain?
D2-044.exp: Storage account ka default access tier hot, cool ya cold ho sakta hai; naye GPv2 accounts hot use karte hain jab tak aap kuch aur na chunein. Archive sirf individual blobs par set ho sakta hai, account default kabhi nahi, kyun ke archived data offline hota hai.

D2-045.q: Blobs ko badle baghair 30 din baad cool mein, 90 din baad archive mein jana chahiye, aur 365 din baad delete hona chahiye. Aap kya configure karenge?
opts: Last modified time par based rules wali lifecycle management policy
Modify effect wali Azure Policy jo access tier badal de
D2-045.exp: Blob lifecycle management mein aap rules likh sakte hain jaise 'last modified 30 din se zyada pehle ho to cool mein, 90 din baad archive mein, 365 din baad delete', aur Azure unhein rozana khud apply karta hai. Azure Policy resource settings govern karti hai, data nahi, aur budgets aur object replication blobs ko tiers ke darmiyan move nahi karte.

D2-046.q: Naya lifecycle management rule banane ke baad us ke actions pehli baar taqreeban kitni der mein chalte hain?
D2-046.exp: Lifecycle policy banane ya badalne ke baad us ko asar mein aane mein 24 ghante tak lag sakte hain, aur rozana ka run khud bhi mukammal hone mein waqt le sakta hai. Is liye blobs pehli baar tier ya delete hone mein taqreeban 48 ghante tak ka intezar karein.

D2-047.q: Blob versioning aur blob snapshots mein asal farq kya hai?
opts: Versioning har write ya delete par khud version banati hai
Snapshots har write par khud bante hain; versions manual hote hain
Versioning ke liye archive tier chahiye
D2-047.exp: Versioning on ho to Azure har baar blob overwrite ya delete hone par pichla version khud rakh leta hai, aap ko kuch nahi karna parta. Snapshot ek read-only copy hai jo aap khud kisi waqt banate hain. Dono pichla content restore kar sakte hain, lekin sirf versioning yeh khud karti hai, aur kisi ko archive tier nahi chahiye.

D2-048.q: Blob soft delete 14 din par set hai. Is ka kya matlab hai?
opts: Blobs 14 din baad archive ho jate hain
Delete hue blobs 14 din ke andar undelete ho sakte hain
Blobs 14 din tak delete nahi ho sakte
Container 14 din ke liye lock ho jata hai
D2-048.exp: Blob soft delete delete (ya overwrite) hue blob ko retention period, yahan 14 din, tak soft-deleted halat mein rakhta hai. Is dauran aap usay undelete kar sakte hain; us ke baad woh permanently hat jata hai. Yeh blobs archive nahi karta, deletion nahi rokta, ya container lock nahi karta.

D2-049.q: Azure Files ke share snapshots kaise hote hain?
opts: Poore share ki read-only point-in-time copies, storage mein incremental
Poore share ki full read-write copies, jo har dafa 100% bill hoti hain
Har ghante automatic aur configure nahi ho sakte
D2-049.exp: Share snapshot poore file share ki read-only point-in-time copy hai. Snapshots incremental hain: sirf pichle snapshot ke baad badla hua data store hota hai, is liye saste hain. Aap unhein manually ya Azure Backup ke schedule par lete hain, aur yeh SMB shares ke liye kaam karte hain.

D2-050.ctx: Invoices (block blobs) GPv2 RA-GRS account mein store hain. Unhein 6 mahine tak foran parhne ke qabil hona chahiye aur kul 7 saal rakhna hai. 6 mahine ke baad foran access ki zaroorat nahi.
D2-050.q: Mahine 7–84 ke liye kaun si tier strategy sab se sasti hai?
opts: Lifecycle rule se cool mein move karein aur versioning on karein
6 mahine baad lifecycle rule se archive mein move karein
Delete kar dein aur zaroorat par dobara upload karein
D2-050.exp: Archive us data ke liye sab se sasta tier hai jo rakhna zaroori ho lekin kam ya kabhi na parha jaye, aur 6 mahine ke baad foran access nahi chahiye. Lifecycle rule invoices ko 6 mahine baad khud move kar sakta hai (archive ka 180 din ka minimum aasani se poora hota hai). Hot aur cool per GB kahin mehnge hain, aur delete karne se 7 saal ki requirement toot jayegi.

D2-201.q: Kaun sa redundancy option sab se kam cost par requirement 2 poori karta hai?
D2-201.exp: Sirf RA- options failover ke baghair kisi bhi waqt secondary region parhne dete hain. RA-GRS RA-GZRS se sasta hai. Saade GRS mein secondary parhne se pehle failover chahiye.

D2-202.q: Requirement 1 ke liye plan mukammal karein.
D2-202.tpl: [[2]] use kar ke blobs ko 30 din baad [[0]] mein aur 180 din baad [[1]] mein move karein.
D2-202.exp: Lifecycle management rule kam use hone wale blobs ko pehle cool aur phir archive mein tier kar sakta hai, jo lambe arse tak rakhne ke liye sab se sasta tier hai. Archive offline hai, jo kam dekhi jane wali videos ke liye qabil-e-qabool hai.

D2-203.q: Partner studios ko kya dena chahiye (requirement 3)?
opts: 7 din ke liye valid account SAS
Container ka service SAS, stored access policy se jura hua
Container ke liye user delegation SAS, 60 din ke liye valid
D2-203.exp: Stored access policy se jura service SAS policy badal ya delete kar ke akele revoke ho sakta hai, doosre tokens par asar dale baghair. User delegation aur account SAS stored access policies use nahi kar sakte; unhein revoke karne ka matlab tamam user delegation keys revoke karna ya account keys rotate karna hai, jo doosre tokens bhi tor deta hai.

opts: Lahore ke storage account mein object replication
Lahore file server par server endpoint aur cloud tiering ke sath Azure File Sync
Har Lahore client par Azure Storage Explorer, share se scheduled download ke sath
D2-204.exp: Azure File Sync ek central Azure file share rakhta hai aur files ko local Windows Server par cache karta hai. Cloud tiering local disk ka istemal kam rakhti hai, aur NTFS permissions baqi rehti hain.

D2-205.q: Requirement 5 ke liye Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: VNet-Prod mein blob service ka private endpoint banayen
Akela service endpoint on-premises clients ko storage account tak privately pohanchne deta hai
Storage account par public network access Disabled karein
Name resolution ke liye privatelink.blob.core.windows.net naam ka private DNS zone chahiye
D2-205.exp: Private endpoint account ko private IP deta hai jis tak VNet aur VPN se jure clients pohanch sakte hain. Service endpoints on-premises tak nahi jate. Public access disable karne se internet block hota hai. Privatelink DNS zone account ka naam private IP par resolve karta hai.

opts: 7 saal retention wala blob soft delete
Container par time-based retention policy (immutable storage)
Storage account aur us ke resource group par ReadOnly resource lock
D2-206.exp: Time-based retention policies blobs ko set period ke liye WORM (write once, read many) bana deti hain. Soft delete ki retention zyada se zyada 365 din hai, aur resource locks blob data ko mehfooz nahi karte.

D2-207.q: Requirement 4 ke liye kaun si DO settings zaroori hain? 2 chunein.
opts: Dono accounts ek hi subscription mein
D2-207.exp: Object replication ke liye source aur destination accounts par versioning aur source par change feed chahiye. Accounts alag subscriptions aur regions mein ho sakte hain.

D2-208.q: Requirements 2 aur 3 ke liye data protection settings mukammal karein.
D2-208.tpl: [[0]] enable karein taa ke overwrite hui reports wapas mil sakein, aur containers ke liye 14 din retention ke sath [[1]].
D2-208.exp: Blob versioning har baar blob overwrite hone par pichla content rakhti hai, is liye aap purane versions wapas la sakte hain. Container soft delete delete hue container ko retention period tak rakhta hai taa ke woh restore ho sake. Akela blob soft delete poora delete hua container wapas nahi lata.

D2-209.q: Reporting app ki managed identity ko kaun sa role milna chahiye (requirement 5)?
opts: Reports container par Storage Blob Data Reader
Storage account ke resource group par Owner
D2-209.exp: Storage Blob Data Reader blob data parhne ka access deta hai. Reader aur Storage Account Contributor control-plane roles hain jo khud data access nahi dete.

D2-210.q: Requirement 6 ke liye aap ko kya chahiye?
opts: Aisi key vault mein customer-managed keys jis mein soft delete aur purge protection ho
Reporting app mein client-side encryption, jis ki keys us ki app settings mein hon
D2-210.exp: Customer-managed keys Northwind ko key ka control aur usay revoke karne ki salahiyat deti hain. Vault mein soft delete aur purge protection honi chahiye, aur account key tak pohanchne ke liye managed identity use karta hai.

D2-211.q: Command mukammal karein taa ke har baar chalne par sirf nayi ya badli hui files upload hon.
D2-211.exp: azcopy sync source aur destination ka muqabla karti hai aur sirf nayi ya badli hui files transfer karti hai, jo baar baar chalne wale job ke liye munasib hai. azcopy copy har baar sab kuch transfer karti hai jab tak aap overwrite options add na karein.

D2-212.q: Sirf upload wali stored access policy ki command mukammal karein.
D2-212.tpl:
az storage container policy create --container-name uploads \
  --name partner --permissions [[0]] --expiry 2026-12-31
D2-212.exp: Stored access policy mein permissions letters hain: r = read, a = add, c = create, w = write, d = delete, l = list. Create (c) aur write (w) partners ko naye blobs upload karne dete hain lekin kuch parhne, list karne ya delete karne nahi dete, jo upload-only access ke mutabiq hai. 'rl' read aur list hai, aur 'racwdl' poora access hai.

D2-213.q: Har maqsad ke liye redundancy chunein.
D2-213.tpl:
Data region se bahar gaye baghair zone outage se bachna: [[0]]
Region outage se bachna aur secondary kisi bhi waqt parhna: [[1]]
D2-213.exp: ZRS ek region ke availability zones mein teen synchronous copies rakhta hai, is liye data region se bahar gaye baghair zone outage se bach jata hai. RA-GRS data paired region mein copy karta hai aur applications ko woh secondary copy kisi bhi waqt parhne deta hai, is liye region outage se bach jata hai. LRS ek datacenter mein rehta hai, aur saada GRS failover tak parha nahi ja sakta.

D2-214.q: Access tiers ke bare mein statements mukammal karein.
D2-214.tpl: Standard priority se archive se blob rehydrate karne mein [[0]] tak lag sakte hain. Cool tier ka early-deletion period [[1]] din hai.
D2-214.exp: Archive se Standard-priority rehydration mein 15 ghante tak lag sakte hain. Har tier ka kam se kam storage period hai: cool 30 din, cold 90 din, archive 180 din. Pehle blobs move ya delete karne par early deletion charge lagta hai.

D2-215.q: Rule mukammal karein taa ke "logs" container ke blobs 30 din baad cool mein jayen aur 365 din baad delete hon.
D2-215.exp: Lifecycle rule mein prefixMatch container ke naam se shuru hota hai, is liye "logs/" logs container ke blobs ko target karta hai. tierToCool action blobs ko 30 din baad move karta hai, aur delete action unhein 365 din baad hata deta hai.

D2-216.q: Commands mukammal karein taa ke sirf office ka public IP 203.0.113.10 account tak pohanch sake.
D2-216.tpl:
az storage account update -n st1 -g RG1 --default-action [[0]]
az storage account network-rule add -n st1 -g RG1 --ip-address [[1]]
D2-216.exp: Network default action Deny karne se firewall on ho jata hai, is liye sirf allowed sources connect kar sakte hain. Phir office ke public IP, 203.0.113.10, ka IP rule add karein. 10.0.0.4 jaise private addresses IP rules mein use nahi ho sakte — un ke liye VNet rules ya private endpoints use karein.

D2-217.q: Azure Files ke identity-based access ke bare mein statement mukammal karein.
D2-217.tpl: Share-level access [[0]] se diya jata hai, aur file aur folder access [[1]] se.
D2-217.exp: Azure Files ke identity-based access ki do tehain hain. Share-level permissions Storage File Data SMB Share Contributor jaise Azure RBAC roles use karti hain. File aur folder permissions Windows NTFS ACLs use karti hain. Access ke liye users ko dono chahiye.

D2-218.q: Kam latency wale premium SMB file shares ki command mukammal karein.
D2-218.tpl:
az storage account create -n stdata01 -g RG1 -l westeurope \
  --sku [[0]] --kind [[1]]
D2-218.exp: Premium (SSD) file shares ke liye Premium_LRS (ya Premium_ZRS) jaisi premium SKU wala FileStorage account chahiye. StorageV2 accounts sirf standard file shares dete hain, aur premium accounts GRS support nahi karte.

D2-219.q: Storage encryption ke bare mein statements mukammal karein.
D2-219.tpl: Infrastructure (double) encryption [[0]] enable ho sakti hai. Customer-managed keys [[1]] configure ho sakti hain.
D2-219.exp: Infrastructure encryption encryption ki doosri teh add karti hai aur sirf account banate waqt on ho sakti hai. Customer-managed keys naye ya mojooda accounts par configure ho sakti hain, aur aap wapas Microsoft-managed keys par ja sakte hain.

D2-220.q: Sync groups ke bare mein statement mukammal karein.
D2-220.tpl: Har sync group mein [[0]] cloud endpoint aur [[1]] server endpoint(s) hote hain.
D2-220.exp: Sync group bilkul ek cloud endpoint (Azure file share) ko ek ya zyada server endpoints (registered servers par paths) se jorta hai. Group ke tamam endpoints cloud share ke zariye ek doosre se sync rehte hain.

D2-221.q: Har requirement ko us sab se saste redundancy option se match karein jo usay poora kare.
items: Region mein zone failure se bachna
Zone aur region dono failures se bachna
Sab se kam cost, ek datacenter
Region outage se bachna aur secondary kisi bhi waqt parhne ke qabil ho
D2-221.exp: ZRS teen zones mein copies rakhta hai, is liye zone failure se bach jata hai. GZRS secondary region mein copy add karta hai, is liye zone aur region dono failures se bachta hai. LRS ek datacenter mein teen copies rakhta hai aur sab se sasta hai. RA-GRS aap ko secondary region kisi bhi waqt parhne deta hai.

D2-222.q: Har zaroorat ko access method se match karein.
items: Sab se mehfooz qisam ka SAS
Bohat se SAS tokens ek sath revoke karna
Entra account ke baghair partner ko waqti access
Azure VM app ko baghair secrets ke blobs parhne dena
D2-222.exp: User delegation SAS Entra credentials se sign hota hai. Stored access policy us se jure tamam SAS revoke karti hai. Service SAS Entra account ke baghair kaam karta hai. Managed identities secrets se bachati hain.

D2-223.q: Har kaam ko tool se match karein.
items: Desktop app mein storage browse aur manage karna
On-premises file server ko Azure Files ke sath cached rakhna
Kam bandwidth mein 80 TB move karna
Folder se incremental uploads script karna
D2-223.exp: Storage Explorer storage browse aur manage karne ki desktop app hai. Azure File Sync on-premises Windows file servers ko Azure Files ke sath cached rakhta hai. Data Box bandwidth kam hone par bohat sara data physical device par bhejta hai. AzCopy scripted, incremental uploads ka command-line tool hai.

D2-224.q: Har workload ko blob type se match karein.
items: VM disk (VHD)
Log entries jorna
Images aur documents
D2-224.exp: Page blobs 512-byte pages mein random reads aur writes ke liye bane hain, isi liye VM disks (VHDs) inhein use karti hain. Append blobs sirf aakhir mein jorne dete hain, logs ke liye behtareen. Block blobs images aur documents jaisi aam files ke liye hain.

D2-225.q: Har zaroorat ko feature se match karein.
items: Compliance ke liye WORM retention
Overwrite ke baad purana content wapas lana
Tafteesh ke dauran data be-muddat rakhna
Delete hua container wapas lana
D2-225.exp: Time-based retention policy compliance ke liye data ko ek muddat tak WORM (write once, read many) banati hai. Blob versioning overwrite ke baad purana content wapas lati hai. Legal hold data ko hold hatne tak be-muddat rakhta hai. Container soft delete delete hua container wapas lata hai.

D2-226.q: Har description ko access tier se match karein.
items: Online, 90+ din rakhe jane wale data ke liye sab se sasti storage
Offline, parhne se pehle rehydrate karna zaroori
Aksar access hone wala data
Online, 30 din ka minimum
D2-226.exp: Cold sab se sasta online tier hai, kam az kam 90 din rakhe jane wale data ke liye. Archive offline hai aur parhne se pehle rehydrate karna parta hai (180 din minimum). Hot aksar access hone wale data ke liye hai. Cool online hai aur 30 din ka minimum hai.

D2-227.q: Har description ko network option se match karein.
items: Ek public IP range allow karna
Account ko aap ke VNet ke andar private IP dena
Muft; subnet ki identity public endpoint ko bhejta hai
D2-227.exp: Firewall IP rule ek public IP range ko account tak pohanchne deta hai. Private endpoint account ko aap ke VNet ke andar private IP deta hai. Service endpoint muft hai aur subnet ki identity account ke public endpoint ko bhejta hai, taa ke VNet rules usay allow kar sakein.

D2-228.q: Har permission ki zaroorat ko Azure Files share-level role se match karein.
items: NTFS permissions bhi badalna
SMB par sirf parhna
SMB par parhna, likhna aur delete karna
targets: Storage File Data SMB Share Reader
Storage File Data SMB Share Contributor
Storage File Data SMB Share Elevated Contributor
D2-228.exp: Storage File Data SMB Share Elevated Contributor files parh, likh aur delete kar sakta hai aur NTFS permissions bhi badal sakta hai. Storage File Data SMB Share Reader read-only hai. Storage File Data SMB Share Contributor parh, likh aur delete kar sakta hai, lekin permissions nahi badal sakta.

D2-229.q: SAS URL dekhein. Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Token blob likhne ki ijazat deta hai
Token saade HTTP par kaam karta hai
Token IP address 198.51.100.4 se kaam karta hai
Token 5 November 2026 ko valid hai
D2-229.exp: sp=r ka matlab read-only hai, is liye token likh nahi sakta. spr=https ka matlab sirf HTTPS hai, is liye saada HTTP fail hota hai. sip callers ko 203.0.113.0–203.0.113.255 tak mehdood karta hai, is liye 198.51.100.4 reject hota hai. st se se tak ki validity mein 5 November shamil hai, is liye tab valid hai.

D2-230.q: Ek block blob 120 din pehle last modify hua tha. Is policy ke tehat woh kis tier mein hai?
D2-230.exp: Policy block blobs ko last modification ke 30 din baad cool aur 90 din baad archive mein le jati hai. 120 din pehle modify hua blob is liye archive mein hai. Woh sirf 2,555 din (taqreeban 7 saal) baad delete hota hai.

D2-231.q: Storage account ki properties dekhein. Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Secondary region se data kisi bhi waqt parha ja sakta hai
Azure Backup jaisi trusted Azure services firewall ke bawajood account tak pohanch sakti hain
Anonymous users "Blob" access wale container mein blob parh sakte hain
Ghar ke internet connection wala client account tak pohanch sakta hai
D2-231.exp: Standard_RAGRS secondary ka read access deta hai. bypass: AzureServices trusted services allow karta hai. allowBlobPublicAccess: false container settings ko override karta hai. Firewall SubnetA ke ilawa sab deny karta hai, aur koi IP rules nahi.

opts: Container "data" ke tamam blobs source account se destination account mein server to server copy karti hai
Blobs local computer par download kar ke phir upload karti hai
Blobs move kar ke source se delete kar deti hai
Dono accounts ke darmiyan sync relationship banata hai jo delete karne tak background mein chalta rehta hai
D2-232.exp: Jab source aur destination dono storage URLs hon to AzCopy server-to-server copy use karta hai, is liye data aap ke computer se nahi guzarta. Command blobs ek baar copy karti hai; unhein source se delete nahi karti ya background mein sync nahi chalati.

D2-233.q: Storage account st1 par SIRF Reader role wala user yeh commands chalata hai. Kya hota hai?
opts: Command authorisation error ke sath fail hoti hai, kyun ke blob data access ke liye Storage Blob Data role chahiye
Blobs list hote hain, lekin downloads fail hote hain
Blobs list ho jate hain, kyunke PowerShell har Reader ke liye account key par chala jata hai
D2-233.exp: -UseConnectedAccount data access ke liye user ki Entra ID identity use karta hai, jis ke liye Storage Blob Data Reader jaisa data-plane role chahiye. Reader control-plane role hai, is liye blobs list karna authorisation error ke sath fail hota hai. PowerShell chupke se account key par nahi jata.

D2-234.q: Object replication policy dekhein. Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Blob invoices/2026/jan.pdf replicate hota hai
Blob invoices/2025/dec.pdf replicate hota hai
Users seedha invoices-copy container mein likh sakte hain
Replication synchronous hai
D2-234.exp: Policy ka prefix filter sirf un blobs ko replicate karta hai jin ke naam 2026/ se shuru hon, is liye invoices/2026 mein jan.pdf replicate hota hai lekin 2025 mein dec.pdf nahi. Policy ke hote hue destination containers read-only hote hain, aur object replication asynchronous hai.

D2-235.q: Yeh command Azure VM se kaam karti hai lekin ghar ke internet wale laptop se "System error 53" ke sath fail hoti hai. Sab se mumkin wajah kya hai?
opts: VM ke mount karne ke baad storage account key rotate ho gayi
ISP ya ghar ka router outbound TCP port 445 block karta hai
Azure Files Windows support nahi karta
D2-235.exp: SMB TCP port 445 use karta hai, jo bohat se internet providers aur ghar ke routers block karte hain. Wahi mount Azure VM se chalta hai, is liye key, share aur quota theek hain. VPN, ExpressRoute ya Azure File Sync use karein, ya provider se port unblock karwayen.

D2-236.q: Yeh Bicep file kya deploy karti hai?
opts: Aisa account jo zone outage se bach jaye, naye blobs default mein cool hon, aur HTTP requests reject hon
Aisa account jo data paired region mein copy kare, aur naye blobs default archive mein hon
Aisa account jis ke blobs default mein archive tier mein hon
Aisa account jis ka naam hamesha bilkul "stapp" ho
D2-236.exp: Standard_ZRS teen zones mein phaila hota hai, accessTier default cool set karta hai, aur supportsHttpsTrafficOnly HTTP reject karta hai. uniqueString() naam ko har resource group ke liye unique banata hai.

D2-237.q: Yeh query kya dikhati hai, aur pehle kya configure karna zaroori hai?
opts: Kis ne aur kis IP se blobs delete kiye; blob logs workspace ko bhejne honge
Har container ki storage capacity; kuch configure nahi karna
Activity log mein record hui blob deletions; account par soft delete enabled hona chahiye
Storage account mein failed sign-ins; Entra ID P2 chahiye
D2-237.exp: StorageBlobLogs mein data-plane operations hote hain. Yeh sirf tab bharta hai jab blob service par diagnostic setting logs Log Analytics mein bheje. Blob deletions Activity log mein nahi hote.

D2-238.q: 5 November ko aap is policy ki Expiry 2026-11-10 kar dete hain. Is ko reference karne wale SAS tokens ka kya hota hai?
opts: Kuch nahi; mojooda tokens purani expiry rakhte hain
Ab woh 10 November ko expire hote hain
Change apply hone se pehle unhein regenerate karna hoga
D2-238.exp: Stored access policy se jure SAS tokens apni expiry policy se lete hain. Policy ki expiry badalne se use reference karne wala har token update ho jata hai, aam tor par taqreeban 30 seconds mein. Woh revoke nahi hote aur regenerate karne ki zaroorat nahi.

D2-239.q: Do storage accounts ke shares dekhein. Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: "linux" share FileStorage (premium) account mein hai
Linux clients "docs" ko NFS par mount kar sakte hain
Windows clients "docs" ko SMB par mount kar sakte hain
"docs" ka quota 5 TiB se aage barh sakta hai
D2-239.exp: NFS shares sirf premium FileStorage accounts par hote hain, is liye "linux" share premium hai. "docs" SMB share hai, is liye Windows clients usay mount kar sakte hain lekin Linux clients NFS par nahi. Pay-as-you-go shares 100 TiB tak barh sakte hain, is liye purani 5 TiB ki had ab nahi.

D2-240.q: Yeh command kis qisam ka SAS banati hai?
opts: Account key se sign hua account SAS
Account key se signed service SAS, jo stored access policy ke expire hone tak valid hai
Microsoft Entra credentials se sign hua user delegation SAS, zyada se zyada 7 din valid
D2-240.exp: --auth-mode login ke sath --as-user user delegation SAS banata hai, jo account key ke bajaye aap ke Microsoft Entra credentials se li gayi key se sign hota hai. User delegation key — aur is liye SAS — zyada se zyada 7 din valid rehti hai. Yeh account SAS, service SAS ya stored access policy nahi.

D2-051.q: Default mein naya bana storage account kahan se connections accept karta hai?
opts: Sirf us VNet se jis mein bana
D2-051.exp: Naye storage accounts default mein tamam networks se pohanch mein hote hain (public network access enabled hota hai), halan ke har request ko phir bhi valid authorisation chahiye. Aap baad mein firewall (selected networks), private endpoints, ya public network access disable kar ke isay mehdood karte hain.

D2-052.q: Kaun si CLI command storage account firewall mein VNet subnet rule add karti hai?
opts: az storage account network-rule add --account-name st1 --vnet-name VNet1 --subnet SubnetA
az network vnet subnet rule add --storage-name st1 --vnet-name VNet1 --subnet SubnetA --allow
D2-052.exp: az storage account network-rule add storage account mein firewall rule add karti hai. Virtual network rule ke liye --vnet-name aur --subnet use karein, ya public IP rule ke liye --ip-address. Subnet par Microsoft.Storage service endpoint bhi hona chahiye. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D2-053.q: Selected networks ke sath firewall enable karne ke baad ek admin ghar se portal mein containers browse nahi kar pata. Azure VMs se us ka data access chalta hai. Kyun?
opts: Portal requests admin ke public IP se aati hain, jo IP rules mein nahi
VNet ke bahar se browse karne ke liye admin ko Owner role chahiye
D2-053.exp: Jab aap portal mein data browse karte hain to requests aap ke browser se aati hain, is liye storage account aap ke ghar ya office ka public IP dekhta hai. Agar woh IP firewall ke IP rules mein nahi to data browsing fail hoti hai, halan ke account settings load ho jati hain. Allowed subnet ki VMs chalti hain kyun ke un ka traffic VNet rule se match karta hai.

D2-054.q: Kya on-premises clients ko allow karne ke liye storage firewall ke IP rules mein private IP range (maslan 10.0.0.0/8) add ho sakti hai?
opts: Nahi — IP rules sirf public IP addresses lete hain
Sirf ExpressRoute Microsoft peering on ho to
D2-054.exp: Storage firewall IP rules sirf public internet addresses lete hain. 10.0.0.0/8 jaisi private ranges allowed nahi, kyun ke on-premises se requests public IP se Azure pohanchti hain. On-premises se private connectivity ke liye VPN ya ExpressRoute se pohanchne wala private endpoint use karein.

D2-055.q: Storage account se alag region ke subnet ko VNet rule se allow karna hai. Kya apply hota hai?
opts: Supported hai: VNet rules doosre regions ke subnets allow kar sakte hain
VNet ko storage account se peer karna hoga
D2-055.exp: Storage service endpoints regions ke aar paar kaam karte hain, is liye VNet rule storage account se alag region ke subnet ko allow kar sakta hai. Is ke liye ZRS ya peering ki zaroorat nahi. Us subnet par Microsoft.Storage service endpoint enable karein aur VNet rule add karein.

D2-056.q: Storage account ko blob aur file dono access ke liye private endpoint chahiye. Kitne private endpoints zaroori hain?
opts: Do — har sub-resource (blob aur file) ke liye ek
Koi nahi; ek service endpoint dono cover karta hai
D2-056.exp: Storage private endpoint ek sub-resource (service) se jurta hai: blob, file, queue, table, web ya dfs. Blob aur file dono tak privately pohanchne ke liye do private endpoints chahiye, har ek apne private DNS zone (privatelink.blob… aur privatelink.file…) ke sath. Service endpoints alag feature hai.

D2-057.q: Blob private endpoints ke liye kaun sa private DNS zone naam use hota hai?
D2-057.exp: Blob private endpoints private DNS zone privatelink.blob.core.windows.net use karte hain. Public naam contosodata.blob.core.windows.net contosodata.privatelink.blob.core.windows.net ka CNAME ban jata hai, jise yeh zone private IP par resolve karta hai. Har service ka apna privatelink zone hai.

D2-058.q: Aap private endpoint banate hain aur storage account ka tamam public internet access block karna chahte hain. Kaun si setting?
D2-058.exp: Public network access Disabled karne se har woh request block hoti hai jo private endpoint se na aaye, internet samet. 'Allow trusted services' kuch Azure services ke liye exception hai, jab ke secure transfer aur minimum TLS transit mein encryption control karte hain, yeh nahi ke kaun se networks connect ho sakte hain.

D2-059.q: Storage private endpoint ke bare mein kaun si DO baatein sahi hain?
opts: Yeh aap ke VNet subnet se ek private IP leta hai
Yeh VPN ya ExpressRoute par on-premises se kaam karta hai
Is ke liye usi subnet par service endpoint chahiye
Yeh account ko publicly readable bana deta hai
D2-059.exp: Private endpoint aap ke subnet ke private IP wala NIC hai jo storage account se jura hota hai. Peered VNets se aur VPN ya ExpressRoute par on-premises se is tak pohancha ja sakta hai. Is ke liye service endpoint nahi chahiye, aur yeh access ko zyada private banata hai, public nahi.

D2-060.q: Storage account par 'Secure transfer required' kya karta hai?
opts: HTTP (aur baghair encryption wale SMB) par aane wali requests reject karta hai
Data at rest encrypt karta hai
Tamam traffic ko private endpoint se guzarne par majboor karta hai
D2-060.exp: 'Secure transfer required' account ko saade HTTP aur baghair encryption wale SMB connections ki requests reject karwata hai, is liye data transit mein hamesha encrypted rehta hai. Yeh encryption at rest (jo hamesha on hai), private endpoints ya MFA control nahi karta.

D2-061.q: Security policy kehti hai ke clients TLS 1.2 ya us se naya use karein. Kaun si storage setting?
D2-061.exp: Storage account par minimum TLS version setting purane TLS wali requests reject karti hai, is liye isay TLS 1.2 karne se TLS 1.0 aur 1.1 clients block ho jate hain. Secure transfer band karne se saada HTTP allow ho jayega, jo zaroorat ka ulat hai, aur baqi options TLS ke bare mein nahi.

D2-062.q: Kaun sa SAS type ek hi token mein kai services (blob, file, queue, table) ka access de sakta hai?
D2-062.exp: Account SAS account key se sign hota hai aur ek token mein kai services (blob, file, queue aur table) aur service-level operations cover kar sakta hai. Service SAS sirf ek service cover karta hai, user delegation SAS services ke aar paar nahi ja sakta, aur stored access policy SAS type nahi.

D2-063.q: SAS URL mein kaun sa parameter expiry time rakhta hai?
D2-063.exp: SAS URL mein se signed expiry time hai. sp permissions rakhta hai, sv storage service version, st start time, aur sig woh signature jo sabit karta hai ke token asli hai.

D2-064.q: SAS URL mein 'sp=rl' ka matlab kya hai?
D2-064.exp: sp parameter SAS ki di hui permissions list karta hai: r = read, l = list, w = write, d = delete, c = create, a = add. Is liye sp=rl blobs parhne aur list karne deta hai, lekin likhne ya delete karne nahi.

D2-065.q: Security ka taqaza hai ke account keys se sign hue tamam SAS block hon jab ke Entra-based access chalta rahe. Aap kya configure karenge?
opts: 'Allow storage account key access' (shared key authorization) disable karein
Har stored access policy delete karein aur dono access keys rozana rotate karein
D2-065.exp: 'Allow storage account key access' (shared key authorization) band karne se account keys se sign hui requests block ho jati hain, account SAS aur service SAS samet. Entra ID access aur user delegation SAS chalte rehte hain, kyun ke woh keys use nahi karte. Keys rotate karna, firewalls aur policies delete karna key-based access block nahi karte.

D2-066.q: User delegation SAS zyada se zyada kitne arse ke liye valid ho sakta hai?
D2-066.exp: User delegation SAS user delegation key se sign hota hai, jo zyada se zyada 7 din valid rehti hai. SAS key se zyada nahi chal sakta, is liye 7 din maximum hai. Account aur service SAS par yeh limit nahi, jo ek wajah hai ke woh zyada risky hain.

D2-067.q: Kaun si CLI command ek blob ke liye SAS banati hai?
D2-067.exp: az storage blob generate-sas ek blob ke liye SAS banati hai, permissions, expiry, IP range aur protocol ke options ke sath. az storage account keys list account keys deti hai, SAS nahi. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D2-068.q: SAS token testing mein chalta hai, phir ek hafte baad partner ke liye 403 errors ke sath fail hota hai. Sab se mumkin wajah kya hai?
opts: SAS expire ho gaya (se guzar gaya) ya signing key rotate hui
Lifecycle policy rule ne blob ka tier cool kar diya
D2-068.exp: Jo SAS chalta tha aur baad mein 403 deta hai woh aksar expire ho chuka hota hai (us ka se waqt guzar gaya) ya invalid ho gaya kyun ke usay sign karne wali key regenerate hui. Doosri wajahen IP ya protocol limits aur firewall rules hain. Tier aur archiving valid SAS tokens par authorisation errors nahi dete.

D2-069.q: Kin levels par stored access policy ho sakti hai?
D2-069.exp: Stored access policies container, file share, queue ya table par define hoti hain, aur us resource ke service SAS tokens unhein reference kar sakte hain. Yeh poore storage account, ek blob, ya storage ke bahar kahin set nahi ho saktin.

D2-070.q: Ek SAS stored access policy 'p1' ko reference karta hai. Aap p1 delete kar ke usi naam 'p1' se nayi policy banate hain. Purane SAS ka kya hota hai?
opts: Nayi p1 ki settings ke tehat dobara valid ho jata hai
Jab tak partner usay dobara sign na kare, invalid rehta hai
Account SAS mein badal jata hai
D2-070.exp: SAS tokens stored access policy ko us ke naam se point karte hain. Agar aap p1 delete kar ke usi naam ki nayi policy banayen to purane tokens nayi policy ki settings ke tehat dobara valid ho jate hain. Tokens hamesha ke liye revoke karne ke liye nayi policy ka naam alag rakhein.

D2-071.q: Stored access policy mein change ko asar mein aane mein kitna waqt lag sakta hai?
D2-071.exp: Stored access policy banane, badalne ya delete karne ke baad asar mein aane mein 30 seconds tak lag sakte hain. Is dauran policy se jure SAS tokens purani settings ke mutabiq chal sakte hain.

D2-072.q: Baghair downtime ke storage account keys rotate karne ke steps tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: key1 regenerate karein
Applications ko key2 use karne par update karein
Applications ko wapas key1 (nayi value) par update karein
key2 regenerate karein
D2-072.exp: Pehle applications ko key2 par le jayen, taa ke key1 use mein na rahe. key1 mehfooz tareeqe se regenerate karein, applications ko nayi key1 par switch karein, aur phir key2 regenerate karein. Har step par applications ke paas valid key rehti hai, is liye kuch band nahi hota.

D2-073.q: Kaun si CLI command primary storage key regenerate karti hai?
opts: az storage account keys renew --account-name st1 --key primary
az storage account update --name st1 --new-key primary --force
D2-073.exp: az storage account keys renew --key primary (ya secondary) do account keys mein se ek regenerate karti hai. Purani key se sign hua koi bhi SAS kaam karna band kar deta hai. az keyvault key rotate Key Vault mein rakhi keys rotate karti hai, storage account keys nahi.

D2-074.q: Kaun sa role user ko storage account access keys list karne deta hai?
opts: Storage Account Key Operator Service Role
Delegation ke sath Storage Blob Data Reader
D2-074.exp: Keys list karne ke liye Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/listkeys/action chahiye. Storage Account Key Operator Service Role, Contributor aur Owner mein yeh shamil hai. Reader, Storage Blob Data Reader aur Monitoring Reader mein nahi.

D2-075.q: Storage account par key expiration policy kya karti hai?
opts: Muqarrar waqfe par keys khud rotate karta hai
Muqarrar waqfe se purani keys ko flag karta hai
D2-075.exp: Key expiration policy set karti hai ke account keys kitni baar rotate honi chahiye (maslan har 90 din). Azure keys aap ke liye rotate nahi karta; waqt guzri keys flag hoti hain taa ke aap unhein rotate karein, aur aap Azure Policy se is ka audit kar sakte hain. Yeh keys delete ya SAS block nahi karti.

D2-076.q: Ek app ko apni managed identity se blobs upload aur delete karne hain. Least-privilege role?
D2-076.exp: Storage Blob Data Contributor blob data parhne, likhne aur delete karne deta hai, jo bilkul app ki zaroorat hai. Storage Blob Data Owner Data Lake par POSIX ACLs bhi manage karta hai, jo zaroorat se zyada hai. Contributor aur Storage Account Contributor control-plane roles hain jo seedha data access nahi dete.

D2-077.q: Ek user ko Data Lake Storage Gen2 account par POSIX ACLs manage karne hain. Kaun sa role?
D2-077.exp: Data Lake Storage Gen2 (hierarchical namespace) par sirf Storage Blob Data Owner, ya file ya directory ka owner user, ownership set aur POSIX access control lists badal sakta hai. Storage Blob Data Contributor data parh aur likh sakta hai lekin ACLs manage nahi kar sakta.

D2-078.q: Ek app ko Entra ID se Azure Storage queue ke messages parhne hain. Kaun sa role?
opts: Storage File Data SMB Share Reader
D2-078.exp: Queue messages data hain, is liye access ke liye queue data role chahiye. Storage Queue Data Message Processor messages peek, parh aur delete kar sakta hai, aur Storage Queue Data Reader unhein parh sakta hai. Blob aur file roles queues par apply nahi hote, aur Reader control-plane role hai.

D2-079.q: Storage Blob Data Reader assign karne ka sab se tang scope kaun sa hai?
D2-079.exp: Storage Blob Data Reader jaise blob data roles ek container jitne tang (ya account, resource group ya subscription jitne wide) scope par assign ho sakte hain. Individual blobs par assign nahi ho sakte. Zyada barik control ke liye ABAC role assignment conditions add karein.

D2-080.q: Kaun si portal setting blob data browse karte waqt portal ko access keys ke bajaye Entra ID use karwati hai?
opts: Default to Microsoft Entra authorization in the Azure portal
Signed-in Azure portal users ke liye blob anonymous access allow karein
D2-080.exp: Storage account ki setting 'Default to Microsoft Entra authorization in the Azure portal' portal ko blobs browse karte waqt account key ke bajaye aap ki Entra identity aur data roles use karwati hai. Baqi settings encryption, Data Lake ya anonymous access ke bare mein hain.

D2-081.q: Kaun sa share-level role users ko SMB par files parhne, likhne aur delete karne deta hai, lekin NTFS permissions badalne nahi deta?
opts: Storage File Data SMB Share Contributor
Storage File Data SMB Share Reader
Storage File Data SMB Share Elevated Contributor
D2-081.exp: Storage File Data SMB Share Contributor SMB par files parhne, likhne aur delete karne deta hai, lekin NTFS permissions badalne nahi deta. Elevated Contributor permissions bhi badal sakta hai, aur Reader read-only hai. Storage Account Contributor control-plane role hai aur files ka access nahi deta.

D2-082.q: Administrators ko Azure file share ke folders par NTFS permissions badalni hain. Unhein kaun sa share-level role chahiye?
opts: Storage File Data SMB Share Elevated Contributor
Storage File Data SMB Share Contributor (Modify)
D2-082.exp: Files aur folders par NTFS permissions badalne ke liye share level par Storage File Data SMB Share Elevated Contributor role chahiye. Aam Contributor role parh, likh aur delete kar sakta hai lekin ACLs nahi badal sakta, aur Reader read-only hai. Storage Blob Data Owner blobs par apply hota hai, file shares par nahi.

D2-083.q: Tamam authenticated identities ko individual assignments ke baghair ek jaisi share-level permission milni chahiye. Aap kya use karenge?
D2-083.exp: Default share-level permission har us authenticated identity par apply hoti hai jis ke paas koi makhsoos role nahi, is liye har user ya group ka assignment nahi chahiye. Phir NTFS ACLs file aur folder access control karti hain. Anonymous access, SAS aur lifecycle rules SMB identity access ke liye kaam nahi karte.

D2-084.q: Azure Files ke liye on-premises AD DS authentication enable karne ke liye storage account ko kya hona chahiye?
opts: AD DS domain mein computer ya service logon account ke taur par joined/registered
Premium FileStorage account mein convert aur domain controller ke VNet mein move kiya gaya
D2-084.exp: AD DS authentication ke liye storage account on-premises AD DS mein computer account ya service logon account ke taur par mojood hona chahiye. Aam tor par AzFilesHybrid PowerShell module yeh set up karta hai. Premium tier, doosra tenant aur RA-GRS zaroori nahi.

D2-085.q: Azure Files ki AD DS authentication chalne ke liye users ke paas kaun si identities honi chahiye?
opts: Entra Connect ke zariye Entra ID mein synced hybrid identities
Cloud-only accounts jin ke paas Entra ID P2 license ho
D2-085.exp: AD DS authentication mein users apne on-premises AD accounts se sign in karte hain, lekin share-level permissions Azure RBAC roles hain, jinhein Entra identity chahiye. Is liye users Entra Connect se AD DS se Entra ID mein synced hybrid identities hone chahiye. Cloud-only, guest aur local accounts on-premises domain mein nahi hote.

D2-086.q: Azure Files access ke bare mein Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Identity-based auth enabled hone par bhi storage account key share mount kar sakti hai
Kisi share-level permission ke baghair sirf NTFS permissions kaafi hain
Azure Files SMB par identity-based auth support karta hai
SMB shares mount karne ke liye SAS tokens use ho sakte hain
D2-086.exp: Identity-based auth on hone par bhi storage account key share ko poore (superuser) access ke sath mount karti hai, is liye usay mehfooz rakhein. Users ko NTFS permissions ke sath share-level permission bhi chahiye. Azure Files SMB par identity-based auth support karta hai. SAS tokens se SMB shares mount nahi hote.

D2-087.q: Security yaqeeni banana chahti hai ke account ka koi bhi container kabhi public set na ho sake. Kaun si account setting?
D2-087.exp: Storage account par 'Allow Blob anonymous access' Disabled karne se har container ka anonymous access block ho jata hai, chahe har container ki apni setting kuch bhi ho. Secure transfer, firewall aur soft delete anonymous reads control nahi karte.

D2-088.q: 'Container' anonymous access level ke sath anonymous users kya kar sakte hain?
opts: Blobs parh sakte hain aur container ke blobs list kar sakte hain
Sirf container ka metadata parh sakte hain, blobs nahi
D2-088.exp: 'Container' anonymous access level har kisi ko blobs parhne aur container ke blobs list karne deta hai. Anonymous users kabhi likh ya delete nahi kar sakte. 'Blob' level list kiye baghair parhne deta hai.

D2-089.ctx: Storage account st1 ka firewall selected networks par set hai aur SubnetA allowed hai. SubnetB mein VM1 par ek user valid SAS use karta hai.
opts: Haan, valid SAS hamesha kaam karta hai
Nahi, firewall ab bhi allowed na hone wale networks ka traffic block karta hai
Haan, bas request HTTPS use kare aur SAS expire na hua ho
D2-089.exp: Firewall SAS se pehle check hota hai. SubnetB ki request allowed network rule se match nahi karti, is liye reject hoti hai chahe SAS token valid ho. Authorisation (SAS, keys, Entra ID) aur network rules alag checks hain, aur dono paas hone chahiye.

D2-090.q: Azure par host apps se blob access ke liye Microsoft kaun sa authorization method recommend karta hai?
opts: Managed identities ke sath Microsoft Entra ID
Encrypted app settings mein rakhi account keys
Code mein embed kiya account SAS
D2-090.exp: Microsoft Azure mein chalne wali apps ke liye managed identities ke sath Microsoft Entra ID authorisation recommend karta hai. Store ya rotate karne ke liye koi secrets nahi, aur RBAC data roles least privilege dete hain. Code ya configs mein rakhi account keys aur SAS tokens leak ho sakte hain, aur anonymous access koi control nahi deta.

D2-091.q: Kaun se DO tareeqe SAS ke zariye diya gaya access revoke karne dete hain?
opts: SAS ki referenced stored access policy delete ya modify karein
SAS sign karne wali account key regenerate karein
D2-091.exp: Stored access policy se jure SAS ke liye policy delete ya badlein. Ad-hoc SAS ke liye usay sign karne wali account key regenerate karein, jo us key se sign hue har SAS ko invalid kar deti hai. Tiers badalna ya versioning on karna SAS par asar nahi dalta.

D2-092.q: Tamam user delegation SAS tokens ko foran invalid kaise karein?
opts: Account ki tamam user delegation keys revoke karein
Account ki dono access keys rotate karein
D2-092.exp: Account ki user delegation keys revoke karne se (maslan az storage account revoke-delegation-keys) har user delegation SAS ek sath invalid ho jata hai. Account keys rotate karne ka un par asar nahi, kyun ke woh Entra credentials se sign hote hain. Containers delete karna ya soft delete badalna unhein revoke nahi karta.

D2-093.q: Storage account par CORS ke bare mein kaun si baat sahi hai?
opts: CORS rules makhsoos origins ki browser apps ko storage endpoints call karne dete hain
CORS rules tay karte hain ke kaun se networks storage firewall se guzar sakte hain
CORS SAS ki jagah leta hai
D2-093.exp: Browsers web pages ko doosre domain ko call karne se rokte hain jab tak woh domain CORS se ijazat na de. Storage account par CORS rules un origins, methods aur headers ki list dete hain jo us ke endpoints call kar sakte hain, taa ke doosre domain ki web app browser se storage use kar sake. CORS firewall, authorisation method ya encryption nahi.

D2-094.q: Sirf VNet1/SubnetA ko storage account st1 tak pohanchne dene ke steps tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: st1 par VNet1/SubnetA ka VNet rule add karein
SubnetA par Microsoft.Storage service endpoint enable karein
st1 ka public network access 'Enabled from selected networks' par set karein
SubnetA ki VM se access test karein
D2-094.exp: Pehle SubnetA par Microsoft.Storage service endpoint enable karein, kyun ke VNet rule ko is ki zaroorat hai. Phir account ko 'Enabled from selected networks' par switch karein aur VNet1/SubnetA ka VNet rule add karein. Aakhir mein us subnet ki VM se test karein. Is tarteeb se rule banne se pehle access band nahi hota.

D2-095.q: Kaun sa feature makhsoos Azure resource instances (maslan ek Synapse workspace) ko storage firewall se guzarne deta hai?
D2-095.exp: Resource instance rules makhsoos Azure resource instances, jaise ek Synapse workspace, ko un ki managed identity ki buniyad par storage firewall se guzarne dete hain. 'Trusted services' poori services allow karta hai, IP rules ko fixed public IPs chahiye, aur private DNS firewall par asar nahi dalta.

D2-096.q: Ek storage account ke alag containers alag customer-managed keys se encrypt hone chahiye. Kaun sa feature?
D2-096.exp: Encryption scopes ek hi storage account ke alag containers ya blobs ko alag encryption keys, alag customer-managed keys samet, use karne dete hain. Infrastructure encryption poore account ke liye doosri teh add karti hai, aur object replication aur immutability keys ke bare mein nahi.

D2-097.q: Storage account Key Vault mein customer-managed key tak pohanchne ke liye kaun si identity use karta hai?
opts: Key permissions wali managed identity (system- ya user-assigned)
Vault par Key Vault Administrator role wala guest user
D2-097.exp: Storage account Key Vault se managed identity (system-assigned ya user-assigned) ke zariye authenticate karta hai jis ke paas key par get, wrap aur unwrap permissions hon. Yeh apni account key ya kisi shakhs ki identity use nahi karta.

D2-098.q: Agar Key Vault mein customer-managed key disable ho jaye to blob access ka kya hota hai?
opts: Key dobara enable hone tak data operations 403 ke sath fail hote hain
Account Microsoft-managed keys par switch ho jata hai
D2-098.exp: Customer-managed keys mein Azure Storage ko data decrypt karne ke liye aap ki key chahiye. Agar key disable ho ya access revoke ho to dobara enable hone tak reads aur writes 403 errors ke sath fail hote hain. Data delete nahi hota, aur account chupke se Microsoft-managed keys par wapas nahi jata.

D2-099.q: Customer-managed keys mein kaun sa option Azure Storage ko rotation ke baad khud sab se naya key version use karne deta hai?
opts: Key URI version ke baghair dein
D2-099.exp: Agar aap key URI version ke baghair configure karein to Key Vault mein key rotate karne ke baad Azure Storage khud sab se naya version use karne lagta hai. Fixed version usi version par rehta hai jab tak aap khud setting update na karein.

D2-100.ctx: st1: firewall = selected networks (SubnetA, office IP 203.0.113.10), shared key access disabled, public anonymous access disabled.
D2-100.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Storage Blob Data Reader wali managed identity ke sath SubnetA ki VM blobs parh sakti hai
Office mein account SAS use karne wala user blobs parh sakta hai
Internet par anonymous user URL se blob parh sakta hai
Storage Blob Data Reader wala office ka user portal mein (Entra auth) blobs parh sakta hai
D2-100.exp: Allowed networks se Entra auth kaam karta hai; account SAS ko shared key auth chahiye, jo disabled hai; anonymous access disabled hai; office IP allowed hai aur Entra auth kaam karta hai.

D2-101.q: In mein se kaun sa storage account ka valid naam hai?
D2-101.exp: Storage account ke naam 3–24 characters lambe, sirf lowercase letters aur numbers wale, aur globally unique hone chahiye kyun ke woh URL ka hissa bante hain. contosodata01 theek hai. 'Contoso-Data' mein capital letter aur hyphen hai, 'contoso_data' mein underscore hai, aur 'cd' bohat chhota hai.

D2-102.q: contosodata naam ke storage account ka blob endpoint format kya hai?
D2-102.exp: Har storage service ka endpoint https://<account>.<service>.core.windows.net format mein hota hai, is liye blob endpoint https://contosodata.blob.core.windows.net hai. azurewebsites.net App Service ke liye hai.

D2-103.q: Kaun si CLI command ZRS ke sath GPv2 account banati hai?
opts: az storage account create -n st1 -g RG1 --sku Standard_ZRS --kind StorageV2
az storage account new -n st1 -g RG1 --redundancy zone --kind BlobStorage
D2-103.exp: az storage account create --sku se performance aur redundancy ek sath set karti hai, is liye Standard_ZRS ka matlab zone-redundant storage wala standard account hai. --kind StorageV2 isay general-purpose v2 banata hai. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D2-104.q: Aap ko asli directories, atomic directory renames aur POSIX ACLs wala data lake chahiye. Account banate waqt kya enable karenge?
D2-104.exp: Hierarchical namespace enable karne se account Data Lake Storage Gen2 ban jata hai: asli directories, poori directories ke atomic renames aur moves, aur POSIX-style access control lists. Large file shares, NFS aur versioning directories ya ACLs nahi dete.

D2-105.q: Ek purane GPv1 account ko access tiers aur lifecycle management chahiye. Aap ko kya karna chahiye?
opts: Premium ke taur par dobara banayen
D2-105.exp: GPv1 accounts access tiers ya lifecycle management support nahi karte. Aap GPv1 account ko usi jagah GPv2 mein upgrade kar sakte hain, data move kiye ya downtime ke baghair, lekin wapas nahi ja sakte. Premium ke taur par dobara banane se tiering khatam ho jayegi, aur versioning ya region badalna account kind nahi badalta.

D2-106.q: Default mein har region har subscription mein kitne storage accounts ban sakte hain?
D2-106.exp: Default mein aap har region har subscription mein 250 storage accounts bana sakte hain, aur support se isay barhwa sakte hain (500 tak). Agar kahin zyada chahiye to accounts ko regions ya subscriptions mein phailayen. Yeh 50 ya unlimited nahi.

D2-107.q: Chhote objects par zyada transaction rates wale workloads ke liye kaun sa premium account type behtareen performance deta hai?
D2-107.exp: Premium BlockBlobStorage accounts SSDs use karte hain aur blobs par zyada transaction rates aur kam latency ke liye bane hain, khaas tor par bohat se chhote objects ke liye. Standard GPv2 hot aur cool HDD-based storage use karte hain, aur FileStorage blobs ke bajaye file shares ke liye hai.

D2-108.q: Aap ko storage se seedha static website (HTML/JS) host karni hai. Aap kya enable karenge?
opts: Static website hosting, jo $web container serve karti hai
Anonymous access, jo $root container publish karta hai
D2-108.exp: Storage account par static website hosting ek khaas $web container ki files website endpoint ke zariye serve karti hai, index page aur error page ke sath. Anonymous container access sirf blob URLs kholta hai. Azure Files aur akela CDN website host nahi karte.

D2-109.q: Kaun sa redundancy option doosre region mein replicate kiye baghair ek availability zone ke outage se bachata hai?
D2-109.exp: ZRS data ko usi region ke teen availability zones mein synchronously copy karta hai, is liye ek zone fail hone par bhi chalta rehta hai aur data kabhi region se bahar nahi jata. LRS ek datacenter mein rehta hai, jab ke GRS aur RA-GRS doosre region mein replicate karte hain.

D2-110.q: Sab se kam cost wala redundancy option kaun sa hai?
D2-110.exp: LRS ek datacenter mein teen copies rakhta hai, is liye sab se sasta option hai lekin sab se kam hifazat deta hai. ZRS (teen zones), GRS (doosra region) aur GZRS (dono) har ek zyada mehnga hai kyun ke woh data ko zyada jagah store karte hain.

D2-111.q: GRS ya RA-GRS account mein kaun si property batati hai ke secondary region kitna peeche hai?
D2-111.exp: Last Sync Time geo-redundant accounts ki property hai. Us waqt se pehle likhi gayi har cheez ka secondary region mein hona yaqeeni hai; us ke baad likhi gayi shayad abhi na ho. Failover se pehle isay check karein taa ke andaza ho ke kitna data kho sakta hai. Change feed aur blob inventory replication ki progress report nahi karte.

D2-112.q: Ek app RA-GRS use karti hai. Account st1 ki secondary blob service se parhne ka endpoint kya hai?
D2-112.exp: RA-GRS ya RA-GZRS mein har service ko secondary endpoint milta hai: account name plus -secondary, maslan https://st1-secondary.blob.core.windows.net. Jab primary available na ho to applications is se parhti hain. Baqi formats mojood nahi.

D2-113.q: Kaun si redundancy sab se zyada durability aur availability deti hai, regional outage ke dauran read access samet?
D2-113.exp: RA-GZRS primary region mein zones ke aar paar teen copies rakhta hai (zone failure se bachta hai), data paired region mein copy karta hai (region outage se bachta hai), aur secondary copy kisi bhi waqt parhne deta hai. GRS mein zone redundancy aur read access nahi, ZRS ek region mein rehta hai, aur LRS ek datacenter mein.

D2-114.q: GRS account par account failover se data loss kyun ho sakta hai?
opts: Secondary mein replication asynchronous hai, is liye haal ki writes shayad copy na hui hon
GRS synchronous hai, is liye failover ke dauran chalne wali writes wapas le li jati hain
D2-114.exp: Secondary region mein geo-replication asynchronous hai: writes primary region mein store hote hi acknowledge ho jati hain, aur thori der baad copy hoti hain. Agar aap failover karein to Last Sync Time ke baad likhi gayi cheezein secondary mein missing ho sakti hain. Failover jaan boojh kar data delete nahi karta, aur GRS synchronous nahi.

D2-115.q: Aap account ko LRS se ZRS mein badalte hain. Yeh kaise hota hai?
opts: Conversion ke zariye (portal mein customer-initiated, ya migration)
Redundancy dropdown se foran, koi data copy hue baghair
D2-115.exp: Zone redundancy mein ya us se bahar jana (LRS ↔ ZRS) conversion mangta hai, jo aap portal mein shuru karte hain (ya manual migration), aur waqt lagta hai kyun ke data zones mein dobara phailaya jata hai. Geo-redundancy add karna (LRS → GRS) saada setting change hai.

D2-116.q: Kaun se DO redundancy options secondary region mein copy rakhte hain?
D2-116.exp: GRS aur GZRS (aur un ke read-access versions RA-GRS aur RA-GZRS) data ko secondary paired region mein copy karte hain. LRS data ek datacenter mein rakhta hai, aur ZRS ek region ke zones mein.

D2-117.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: GRS kul 6 copies rakhta hai
ZRS poore region ke outage se bachata hai
GRS ka secondary region aap apni marzi se chunte hain
RA-GRS failover ke baghair secondary parhne deta hai
D2-117.exp: GRS 6 copies rakhta hai: 3 primary region mein aur 3 secondary mein. ZRS ek region ke andar rehta hai, is liye region outage se nahi bachata. Aap secondary region nahi chun sakte — woh paired region hota hai. RA-GRS failover ke baghair kisi bhi waqt secondary parhne deta hai.

D2-118.q: App ko region ka ek datacenter fail hone par bhi available rehna hai, aur data residency rules region se bahar jane nahi dete. Kya chunenge?
D2-118.exp: ZRS usi region ke teen availability zones (alag datacenters) mein teen synchronous copies rakhta hai. Ek datacenter fail ho to data phir bhi available rehta hai, aur kabhi region se bahar nahi jata. GRS, RA-GRS aur GZRS sab data doosre region mein copy karte hain, jo residency requirement tor deta hai.

D2-119.q: Object replication kaun se blob types support karta hai?
D2-119.exp: Object replication block blobs ko source account se destination account mein asynchronously copy karta hai. Yeh sirf block blobs support karta hai: page blobs (VM disks ke liye) aur append blobs (logs ke liye) replicate nahi ho sakte, is liye 'tamam blob types' ghalat hai.

D2-120.q: Object replication policy mein kaun sa filter replication ko un blobs tak mehdood karta hai jin ke naam 'invoices/' se shuru hon?
D2-120.exp: Object replication rules mein prefix match filter ho sakta hai, maslan 'invoices/', taa ke sirf woh blobs replicate hon jin ke naam is text se shuru hon. Aap creation time se bhi filter kar sakte hain. Tags, tiers aur lifecycle rules replication ka scope tay nahi karte.

D2-121.q: Kya archive tier ke blobs object replication se replicate ho sakte hain?
opts: Nahi — archive blobs replicate nahi hote
Sirf jab account RA-GRS use kare
