D2-121.exp: Archive tier ke blobs object replication se replicate nahi hote, kyun ke archived data offline hota hai. Agar unhein replicate karna ho to pehle online tier mein rehydrate karein. Redundancy aur 180 din ka minimum is ko nahi badalte.

D2-122.q: Object replication mein destination container kya ban jata hai?
D2-122.exp: Jab tak object replication policy lagi hai, destination container clients ke liye read-only rehta hai; sirf replication process us mein likhta hai. Is se copy source ke mutabiq rehti hai. Us mein dobara likhne ke liye policy hatayen.

D2-123.q: st-src se st-dst tak object replication configure karne ke steps tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: st-dst / st-src par replication policy aur rules banayen
Dono accounts par blob versioning enable karein
st-src par change feed enable karein
Test blob upload kar ke replication status verify karein
D2-123.exp: Object replication ke liye dono accounts par versioning aur source par change feed chahiye, is liye pehle unhein on karein. Phir replication policy aur us ke rules banayen. Aakhir mein test blob upload kar ke us ka replication status check karein. Prerequisites se pehle policy banana fail hota hai.

D2-124.q: Azure Storage SSE kaun sa encryption algorithm use karta hai?
D2-124.exp: Azure Storage tamam data at rest ko 256-bit AES se encrypt karta hai, jo sab se mazboot block ciphers mein se hai, aur FIPS 140-2 compliant hai. DES kamzor aur purana hai, RSA asymmetric hai (bulk data ke liye use nahi hota), aur MD5 hash hai, encryption nahi.

D2-125.q: Azure Storage ki customer-managed key kahan store ho sakti hai?
opts: Azure Key Vault ya Key Vault Managed HSM
D2-125.exp: Azure Storage ki customer-managed keys Azure Key Vault ya Azure Key Vault Managed HSM mein rakhni hoti hain. Storage account managed identity ke zariye key tak pohanchta hai. Keys storage account, App Service ya Entra ID mein store nahi ho sakti.

D2-126.q: Compliance ka taqaza hai ke Microsoft nahi balke customer key rotation control kare aur tamam storage data ka access revoke kar sake. Aap kya configure karenge?
D2-126.exp: Key Vault mein customer-managed keys ke sath key aap ki hai: aap control karte hain ke woh kab rotate ho, aur usay disable ya delete kar ke account ke tamam data ka access kaat sakte hain. Microsoft-managed keys mein Microsoft unhein rotate karta hai aur aap is tarah access revoke nahi kar sakte. Infrastructure encryption aur secure transfer key ka control nahi dete.

D2-127.q: Client ko upload karne se pehle apni taraf data encrypt karna hai, taa ke Azure kabhi plaintext na dekhe. Kaun sa tareeqa?
D2-127.exp: Client-side encryption (Azure Storage client libraries mein available) data ko upload hone se pehle aap ki application ke andar encrypt karti hai, is liye Azure sirf ciphertext store karta aur dekhta hai. Server-side encryption aur infrastructure encryption data pohanchne ke baad Azure mein hoti hain, aur secure transfer sirf transit mein data bachata hai.

D2-128.q: Kaun si AzCopy command do storage accounts ke darmiyan blob seedha (server-to-server) copy karti hai?
D2-128.exp: Jab source aur destination dono storage URLs hon to azcopy copy server-to-server copy use karti hai: data aap ke computer se nahi balke seedha storage accounts ke darmiyan move hota hai. azcopy move aur azcopy transfer mojood nahi, aur --local ke sath sync valid nahi.

D2-129.q: Kaun sa AzCopy option folder aur us ke tamam subfolders copy karta hai?
D2-129.exp: --recursive AzCopy ko folder aur us ke tamam subfolders ki har file shamil karne ka kehta hai. Is ke baghair AzCopy sirf folder ke top level ki files copy karta hai. --all, --deep aur --include-subdirs AzCopy options nahi.

D2-130.q: Ek AzCopy job aadhe mein ruk gaya. Dobara shuru kiye baghair usay kaise jari rakhein?
opts: Delete kar ke dobara shuru karein
D2-130.exp: AzCopy har job ki plan file save karta hai. Agar job beech mein ruk jaye to azcopy jobs resume <job-id> dobara shuru karne ke bajaye wahin se jari rakhta hai jahan ruka tha. Job ID azcopy jobs list se dhoondein. --overwrite ke sath dobara copy karne se files dobara transfer hongi.

D2-131.q: --delete-destination=true ke sath azcopy sync kya karta hai?
opts: Destination par woh files delete karta hai jo ab source par mojood nahi
Files kamyabi se copy hone ke baad source se delete karta hai
D2-131.exp: --delete-destination=true ke sath azcopy sync destination par woh files bhi delete karta hai jo ab source par mojood nahi, is liye destination bilkul aaina ban jata hai. Default mein sync sirf nayi aur badli hui files copy karta hai aur kabhi delete nahi karta. Yeh source ko nahi chhoota.

D2-132.q: Kaun si AzCopy command Entra identity se sign in karti hai?
D2-132.exp: azcopy login AzCopy ko Microsoft Entra ID se sign in karti hai, ya to interactively, ya managed identity ke liye --identity se, ya service principal se. Us ke baad aap ko URLs mein SAS tokens ki zaroorat nahi. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D2-133.q: Aap azcopy login se sign in karte hain. Blobs upload karne ke liye aap ki identity ke paas kaun sa role hona chahiye?
D2-133.exp: Entra ID sign-in mein blobs upload karna data-plane operation hai, is liye aap ki identity ko Storage Blob Data Contributor ya Storage Blob Data Owner jaisa data role chahiye. Reader, Contributor aur Storage Account Contributor control-plane roles hain aur khud data access nahi dete.

D2-134.q: Storage Explorer kin tareeqon se storage se connect ho sakta hai?
opts: Entra sign-in, account name aur key, SAS URL, connection string
Sirf subscription par Owner role ke sath Entra sign-in
D2-134.exp: Storage Explorer Microsoft Entra ID se sign in kar ke, account name aur key se, SAS URL se, connection string se, aur local Azurite emulator se connect ho sakta hai. Yeh ek tareeqe tak mehdood nahi aur portal ki zaroorat nahi.

D2-135.q: Storage Explorer tez upload aur download transfers ke liye andar se kya use karta hai?
D2-135.exp: Storage Explorer uploads, downloads aur accounts ke darmiyan copies ke liye peeche AzCopy use karta hai, jis se tez, parallel transfers milte hain. Robocopy, FTP aur rsync use nahi hote, aur scripted transfers ke liye aap AzCopy khud bhi chala sakte hain.

D2-136.q: Slow internet link wali jagah se taqreeban 40 TB Azure par move karna hai. Kaun sa option is ke liye bana hai?
opts: Azure Data Box (site par bheja jane wala appliance)
D2-136.exp: Data Box offline transfer appliance hai: aap site par data us mein copy kar ke Microsoft ko bhejte hain, jis se slow link par hafton ki upload se bach jate hain. AzCopy, File Sync aur Storage Explorer sab network par depend karte hain.

D2-137.q: Azure Import/Export service ke liye kaun sa tool import ke liye drives tayyar karta hai?
D2-137.exp: Azure Import/Export service ke liye aap WAImportExport tool se drives tayyar karte hain. Yeh data disks par copy karta hai, unhein BitLocker se encrypt karta hai, aur woh journal files banata hai jo Azure ko data import karne ke liye chahiye. AzCopy aur Storage Explorer is ke bajaye network par data transfer karte hain.

D2-138.q: Analytics team ko reports ke liye rozana CSV chahiye jis mein tamam blobs un ke tier aur size ke sath list hon. Kaun sa feature?
D2-138.exp: Blob inventory rozana ya haftawar schedule par chalti hai aur CSV ya Parquet report likhti hai jis mein aap ke blobs tier, size aur last modified time jaisi properties ke sath list hote hain. Change feed mojooda halat list karne ke bajaye changes record karta hai, aur lifecycle management data move karta hai, report nahi karta.

D2-139.q: Auditing aur aage processing ke liye aap ko har blob create, update aur delete ka tarteeb-war, durable log chahiye. Kaun sa feature?
D2-139.exp: Change feed account ke blobs par har create, update aur delete ka tarteeb-war, durable, read-only log hai, jo khud account mein rakha jata hai. Applications isay auditing ke liye ya processing trigger karne ke liye parh sakti hain. Soft delete, versioning aur snapshots purana data rakhte hain, lekin event log nahi.

D2-140.q: Kaun si setting SIRF storage account banate waqt chuni ja sakti hai?
D2-140.exp: Infrastructure encryption — service level ke neeche encryption ki doosri teh — sirf storage account banate waqt on ho sakti hai. Default access tier, firewall rules aur minimum TLS version sab baad mein badle ja sakte hain.

D2-141.q: Storage account banne ke baad kaun si setting badli ja sakti hai?
D2-141.exp: Aap default access tier ko kisi bhi waqt hot, cool aur cold (aur zone-redundant accounts par smart) ke darmiyan badal sakte hain. Performance tier (Standard ya Premium), premium account kind aur account ka naam banne ke baad fixed hote hain — is ke liye naya account bana kar data copy karna hoga.

D2-142.q: Aap ko storage account West Europe se North Europe move karna hai. Supported tareeqa?
opts: North Europe mein naya account banayen aur data us mein copy karein
Object replication use karein aur phir account failover shuru karein
D2-142.exp: Storage account ka region nahi badal sakta. Move karne ke liye North Europe mein naya account banayen (settings copy karne ke liye asal ka template export kar sakte hain), AzCopy waghera se data copy karein, applications ko naye account par point karein, aur phir purana delete karein. Koi region property ya move command nahi.

D2-143.q: Kaun sa metric storage account par throttling pakarne mein madad karta hai?
opts: ResponseType se filter kiya gaya Transactions
Access tier se filter ki gayi used capacity
D2-143.exp: Jab account throttle hota hai to requests ServerBusyError jaise errors ke sath fail hoti hain. Transactions metric ko ResponseType dimension se split karein taa ke dekhein kitni requests ne throttling errors diye. Capacity, ingress aur blob count throttling nahi dikhate.

D2-144.q: Storage blob read, write aur delete logs Log Analytics mein kaise bhejte hain?
opts: Blob service par diagnostic setting banayen
Account par Azure Monitor Agent install karein
D2-144.exp: Storage resource logs (StorageRead, StorageWrite, StorageDelete) makhsoos service, jaise blob, par bani diagnostic setting ke zariye bheje jate hain, Log Analytics workspace destination ke sath. Soft delete aur versioning data bachate hain, aur storage accounts par agent nahi chalta.

D2-145.q: Tier costs ke bare mein kaun si baat sahi hai?
opts: Hot ki storage cost sab se zyada aur access cost sab se kam
Archive ki storage cost sab se zyada aur access cost kuch nahi
Tamam tiers ki cost ek jaisi hai
Cool ki koi access cost nahi
D2-145.exp: Hot se cool, cold aur archive ki taraf jane se per GB storage price kam hoti hai lekin data access ki cost barhti hai. Hot parhne mein sab se sasta aur store karne mein sab se mehnga hai; archive store karne mein sab se sasta lekin wapas parhne mein mehnga aur slow hai. Hot ke ilawa har tier per GB read par bhi charge karta hai.

D2-146.q: Data 2 hafte tak aksar parha jata hai aur phir kam chhua jata hai lekin ek saal tak foran available rehna chahiye. Sab se sasta sahi tareeqa?
opts: Hot mein upload karein, phir lifecycle rule 14 din baad cool (ya cold) mein le jaye
Seedha archive mein upload karein, phir read hone par lifecycle rule usay hot mein le aaye
Ek saal tak hot mein rakhein
D2-146.exp: Hot access mein sab se sasta hai, jo pehle 2 hafton ke liye munasib hai. Us ke baad cool ya cold store karne mein saste hain aur online hain, is liye data foran available rehta hai. Lifecycle rule isay khud move karta hai. Archive data ko offline kar dega, aur premium ya saal bhar hot zyada mehnga hai.

D2-147.q: Kaun sa PowerShell cmdlet storage account banata hai?
D2-147.exp: New-AzStorageAccount storage account banata hai (-ResourceGroupName, -Name, -Location, -SkuName aur -Kind ke sath). Set-AzStorageAccount mojooda account badalta hai. New-AzStorage aur Add-AzStorageAccount mojood nahi.

D2-148.q: Aap 'Allow cross-tenant replication = false' enable karte hain. Kis par asar hota hai?
opts: Object replication policies doosre Entra tenants ke accounts use nahi kar saktin
Doosri geography ke paired region mein geo-replication kaam karna chhor deti hai
D2-148.exp: 'Allow cross-tenant replication' = false object replication policies ko doosre Microsoft Entra tenant ka source ya destination account use karne se rokta hai. Is ka geo-replication (GRS), private endpoints ya SAS par asar nahi.

D2-149.ctx: Ek application bohat tez rate par telemetry blobs likhti hai aur use single-digit millisecond latency chahiye. Ek zone ka data loss qabil-e-qabool hai, lekin cost munasib honi chahiye.
D2-149.q: Kaun si account configuration behtareen hai?
D2-149.exp: Premium BlockBlobStorage single-digit millisecond latency aur bohat zyada transaction rates ke liye SSDs use karta hai, jo bhaari telemetry ingestion ke liye munasib hai. LRS cost kam rakhta hai, aur yahan zone ki resilience khona qabil-e-qabool hai. Standard GPv2 slow hai, archive offline hai, aur FileStorage file shares ke liye hai.

D2-150.ctx: Account st1: Standard GPv2, RA-GZRS, versioning on, change feed on, Key Vault mein CMK (soft delete + purge protection).
D2-150.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: st1 object replication policy ka source ho sakta hai
st1 primary region mein zone outage se baghair data loss ke bach jata hai
Key Vault mein key disable karne se st1 ka data parhna block ho jata hai
st1 ko usi jagah Premium performance mein convert kiya ja sakta hai
D2-150.exp: Versioning (change feed ke sath) object replication source ki requirements poori karti hai. RA-GZRS zones mein synchronously likhta hai, is liye zone outage mein data nahi khota. Customer-managed keys ke sath key disable karne se data ka access block ho jata hai. Standard se Premium usi jagah nahi badla ja sakta.

D2-151.q: Kaun sa blob type logging jaise sirf append wale operations ke liye optimized hai?
D2-151.exp: Append blobs sirf aakhir mein blocks jorne dete hain, mojooda data kabhi nahi badalte, jo unhein logs aur audit trails ke liye behtareen banata hai. Page blobs random read/write (disks) ke liye hain, block blobs aam files ke liye, aur 'archive blob' koi blob type nahi.

D2-152.q: Blob storage mein container hierarchy kya hai?
D2-152.exp: Storage account mein containers hote hain, aur containers mein blobs. File shares (directories ke sath) Azure Files ka hissa hain, jo usi account mein alag service hai.

D2-153.q: Kaun si CLI command 'images' naam ka container banati hai?
opts: az storage container create --name images --account-name st1 --auth-mode login
az storage share create --name images --account-name st1 --auth-mode login --container
D2-153.exp: az storage container create --name images blob container banati hai. --auth-mode login account key ke bajaye aap ki Entra identity use karta hai (aap ko Storage Blob Data role chahiye). az storage share create file share banati hai, aur az container create container instance (ACI) banati hai.

D2-154.q: Kaun si CLI command local file ko container mein upload karti hai?
opts: az storage blob upload --container-name images --file photo.jpg --name photo.jpg --account-name st1
az storage file upload --share-name images --source photo.jpg --path photo.jpg --account-name st1
D2-154.exp: az storage blob upload ek local file (--file) ko container (--container-name) mein blob ke naam (--name) se upload karti hai. az storage file upload Azure file shares ke liye hai, aur baqi commands mojood nahi.

D2-155.q: Apps ko containers ke aar paar project=alpha jaise key-value attributes se blobs dhoondne hain. Kaun sa feature?
D2-155.exp: Blob index tags key-value pairs hain jinhein Azure Storage index karta hai, is liye aap Find Blobs by Tags se tamam containers mein search kar sakte hain (maslan project = 'alpha'). Blob metadata index ya searchable nahi, resource tags individual blobs ke bajaye Azure resources par lagte hain, aur lifecycle rules search nahi karte.

D2-156.q: Din mein kai baar access hone wale data ke liye kaun sa tier munasib hai?
D2-156.exp: Hot tier ki per access cost sab se kam hai aur koi minimum storage period nahi, is liye aksar parhe ya likhe jane wale data ke liye yahi sahi hai. Cool, cold aur archive har read par zyada charge karte hain aur un ke minimum periods hain, jo masroof data ke liye mehnga hai.

D2-157.q: Backups kam access hote hain, kam az kam 90 din rakhe jate hain, aur zaroorat par milliseconds mein available hone chahiye. Sab se cost-effective online tier?
D2-157.exp: Cold online tier hai, is liye data milliseconds mein available hota hai, lekin storage hot aur cool se sasti hai. Is ka 90 din ka minimum kam az kam 90 din rakhe jane wale backups ke mutabiq hai. Archive aur bhi sasta hai lekin offline (parhne mein ghante), aur hot ya premium zaroorat se zyada mehnge honge.

D2-158.q: Agar archived blob 10 GB se chhota ho to usay ek ghante ke andar kaise parhein?
opts: Usay archive tier mein copy karein
D2-158.exp: Archive se rehydrate karne ki do priorities hain. High priority aam tor par 10 GB se chhote blobs ke liye ek ghante se kam mein mukammal hoti hai, zyada cost par. Standard priority mein 15 ghante tak lag sakte hain. Archive mein copy karna usay offline hi rakhta hai, aur soft delete rehydrate nahi karta.

D2-159.q: Kaun se DO tareeqe blob ko archive se rehydrate karte hain?
opts: Us ka tier hot, cool ya cold karein (Set Blob Tier)
Usay online tier ke naye blob mein copy karein (Copy Blob)
D2-159.exp: Archived blob ko do tarah rehydrate kar sakte hain: Set Blob Tier se us ka tier hot, cool ya cold karein, ya Copy Blob se usay online tier ke naye blob mein copy karein, jo archived asal ko rakhta hai. Versioning aur snapshots data ko wapas online nahi late.

D2-160.q: Ek blob cool mein move hua aur 10 din baad delete hua. Kaun sa charge lagta hai?
opts: Baqi 20 din ka early deletion charge
Baqi 170 din ka early deletion charge
D2-160.exp: Cool tier ka 30 din ka minimum hai. 10 din baad blob delete karne par baqi 20 din ki cool storage ka early-deletion charge (prorated) lagta hai. Rehydration charge nahi kyun ke cool online hai, aur 180 din archive ka minimum hai.

D2-161.q: Kya Premium block blob account mein blob par archive tier set ho sakta hai?
opts: Nahi, premium block blob accounts hot/cool/cold/archive tiering support nahi karte
Haan, lekin sirf base blobs par lagne wale lifecycle management rule se
D2-161.exp: Premium block blob accounts hot, cool, cold ya archive access tiers support nahi karte; tamam data premium SSD storage par hota hai. Data archive karne ke liye usay standard GPv2 account mein copy kar ke wahan tier karein.

D2-162.q: Archive tier ke liye kaun si redundancy setting supported NAHI?
D2-162.exp: Archive tier sirf LRS, GRS ya RA-GRS use karne wale accounts ke liye supported hai. ZRS, GZRS ya RA-GZRS wale accounts blobs ko archive mein nahi le ja sakte, is liye agar archive chahiye to supported redundancy options mein se ek chunein.

D2-163.q: Lifecycle rule ka asar sirf container 'app' ke 'logs/' folder ke blobs par hona chahiye. Filter mein kya set karenge?
D2-163.exp: Lifecycle rule ka prefixMatch filter container ke naam se shuru hota hai, is liye 'app/logs/' rule ko app container ke logs folder ke blobs tak mehdood karta hai. blobTypes filter block ya append blobs chunta hai, folders nahi. Account tags aur resource locks lifecycle rules ka scope tay nahi karte.

D2-164.q: Lifecycle rule ko woh blobs cool mein le jane chahiye jo 60 din se PARHE nahi gaye. Kya enable hona chahiye?
D2-164.exp: Blob ke aakhri baar parhe jane par based rules (daysAfterLastAccessTimeGreaterThan) ke liye account par last access time tracking enabled honi chahiye; warna Azure reads record nahi karta. Last modification par based rules ko is ki zaroorat nahi. Versioning, change feed aur soft delete shamil nahi.

D2-165.q: Kaun sa lifecycle action purane blob versions ko previous versions banne ke 90 din baad delete karta hai?
opts: Version action: daysAfterCreationGreaterThan 90 ke sath delete
D2-165.exp: Lifecycle rules mein current blob (baseBlob), snapshots aur versions ke alag action blocks hote hain. Purane versions saaf karne ke liye version action add karein: daysAfterCreationGreaterThan 90 ke sath delete, jo us waqt se ginta hai jab version previous version bana. baseBlob action is ke bajaye current blobs delete kar dega.

D2-166.q: Lifecycle management kaun se blob types ko hot, cool aur archive ke darmiyan tier kar sakta hai?
D2-166.exp: Lifecycle management block blobs ko hot, cool, cold aur archive ke darmiyan move aur delete kar sakta hai. Append blobs sirf delete action support karte hain, aur page blobs bilkul supported nahi. Is liye tiering sirf block blobs par chalti hai.

D2-167.q: Aam lifecycle policy purane hote data ko jin tiers se guzarti hai unhein pehle se aakhir tak tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: Archive
Hot
Delete
Cool
D2-167.exp: Data purana hone ke sath kam access hota hai, is liye saste tiers mein jata hai: hot se shuru hota hai, cool mein jata hai, phir lambe arse ke liye archive mein, aur aakhir mein jab rakhna zaroori na ho to delete ho jata hai.

D2-168.q: Versioning enabled hai aur ek user ghalti se blob overwrite kar deta hai. Pichla content kaise wapas layenge?
opts: Previous version ko current version bana dein (promote)
Container undelete karein, jis se pichla content wapas aata hai
D2-168.exp: Versioning on ho to har overwrite pichle content ko purane version ke taur par rakhta hai. Wapas lane ke liye us previous version ko promote (restore) karein taa ke woh dobara current blob ban jaye. Snapshot ki zaroorat nahi, aur container undelete poore containers ke liye hai.

D2-169.q: Versioning enabled hai aur ek blob delete hota hai. Kya hota hai?
opts: Current version previous version ban jata hai
Blob aur tamam versions delete ho jate hain
Blob archive mein chala jata hai
D2-169.exp: Versioning on ho to blob delete karne se us ka data khatam nahi hota. Current version previous version ban jata hai, jise aap baad mein restore kar sakte hain. Data tab tak rehta hai jab tak woh versions delete na hon, maslan lifecycle rule se.

D2-170.q: Aksar overwrite hone wale data par blob versioning enable karne mein cost ka kya pehlu hai?
opts: Har version bill hota hai, is liye storage cost barh sakti hai
Versions alag account mein store hote hain
D2-170.exp: Har version ek poora blob hai jis ki storage ka aap ko bill aata hai. Agar data aksar overwrite ho to versions jama hote jate hain aur storage cost barhti hai. Ek khaas umar se purane versions delete karne ke liye lifecycle rule use karein. Versions usi account mein rehte hain aur tiers ke sath kaam karte hain.

D2-171.q: Kisi ne ghalti se poora container delete kar diya. Kaun sa feature usay restore karne deta hai?
D2-171.exp: Container soft delete delete hue container, aur us ke tamam blobs, ko retention period tak rakhta hai taa ke aap usay restore kar sakein. Blob soft delete aur versioning individual blobs ko bachate hain, lekin poore container ke delete hone se nahi.

D2-172.q: Blob soft delete ki retention kitni range mein set ho sakti hai?
D2-172.exp: Blob soft delete (aur container soft delete) ki retention 1 se 365 din ke darmiyan kahin bhi set ho sakti hai. Is dauran delete hua blob undelete ho sakta hai; us ke baad data permanently hat jata hai. Baqi ranges ghalat hain.

D2-173.q: Ek kharab batch job ke baad aap ko kuch block blobs ko 3 din pehle wali halat mein restore karna hai. Kaun sa feature?
opts: Block blobs ke liye point-in-time restore
D2-173.exp: Point-in-time restore container (ya account) ke block blobs ko pehle ke kisi waqt ki halat mein wapas le jata hai, jo kharab batch job ke baad behtareen hai. Is ke liye versioning, change feed aur blob soft delete enabled hone chahiye. Share snapshots Azure Files ke liye hain, object replication data copy karta hai, aur rehydration archive ke liye hai.

D2-174.q: Block blobs ke liye point-in-time restore use karne se pehle kaun se TEEN features enable hone chahiye?
D2-174.exp: Point-in-time restore block blobs ko pehle ke waqt par wapas le jata hai. Is ke liye blob soft delete, blob versioning aur change feed teeno enabled hone chahiye, kyun ke yeh change log aur stored versions se pichli halat dobara banata hai. Static websites aur hierarchical namespace zaroori nahi (aur hierarchical namespace supported bhi nahi).

D2-175.q: Regulations ka taqaza hai ke financial records 7 saal tak badle ya delete na ho sakein (WORM). Kaun sa feature?
opts: Time-based retention policy ke sath immutable storage
Account par 7 saal ki expiry wala ReadOnly resource lock
D2-175.exp: Time-based retention policy wali immutable storage blobs ko WORM halat (write once, read many) mein dal deti hai: retention period ke dauran koi, administrator bhi, unhein badal ya delete nahi kar sakta. Soft delete aur versioning phir bhi deletion allow karte hain, aur ReadOnly resource lock account ki settings bachata hai, blob data nahi.

D2-176.q: Tafteesh ke dauran data ko be-muddat, baghair kisi fixed end date ke, mehfooz rakhna hai. Kaun si immutability policy?
D2-176.exp: Legal hold data ko baghair end date ke immutable banata hai; yeh tab tak rehta hai jab tak koi usay saaf na kare, jo tafteesh ya muqadme ke liye munasib hai. Time-based retention policy ko fixed period chahiye. Soft delete aur lifecycle rules deletion nahi rokte.

D2-177.q: Time-based retention policy lock karne se kya hota hai?
opts: Retention waqfa kam nahi ho sakta aur policy delete nahi ho sakti
Retention waqfa kam ho sakta hai, lekin policy barhayi nahi ja sakti
D2-177.exp: Time-based retention policy lock hone ke baad hataayi nahi ja sakti aur us ka retention period kam nahi ho sakta; aap sirf usay barha sakte hain. Yeh SEC 17a-4 jaise regulations poore karta hai. Unlocked policy ab bhi badli ya delete ho sakti hai, isi liye compliance ke liye usay lock karte hain.

D2-178.q: Azure Files shares kaun se protocols use kar sakte hain?
D2-178.exp: Azure Files shares tak SMB (Windows, macOS, Linux) ya NFS (Linux, sirf premium accounts) se, aur REST API se pohancha jata hai. FTP, SFTP aur iSCSI Azure Files ke protocols nahi.

D2-179.q: Kaun si CLI command 'docs' naam ka 100 GiB file share banati hai?
opts: az storage share-rm create --storage-account st1 --name docs --quota 100
az storage container create --storage-account st1 --name docs --size 100
D2-179.exp: az storage share-rm create Azure Resource Manager ke zariye file share banati hai, aur --quota size GiB mein set karta hai. az storage container create blob container banati hai, file share nahi, aur baqi commands mojood nahi.

D2-180.q: Standard file share ke kaun se tiers hain?
D2-180.exp: Standard (HDD) file shares transaction optimized, hot ya cool ho sakte hain, jo is hisaab se chune jate hain ke files kitni baar access hoti hain. Premium (SSD) shares FileStorage accounts mein hote hain. File shares ke liye archive available nahi.

D2-181.q: Pay-as-you-go (HDD) Azure file share ka zyada se zyada size kya hai?
D2-181.exp: Har pay-as-you-go Azure file share ab 100 TiB tak barh sakta hai. Purani 5 TiB ki had, jisay barhane ke liye large file shares setting chahiye thi, ab nahi rahi. Provisioned v2 shares us se bhi bare, 256 TiB tak, ho sakte hain.

D2-182.q: Windows machine par Azure file share kaise mount karte hain?
opts: iSCSI LUN ki tarah map karein
D2-182.exp: Windows par aap Azure file share ko SMB par us ke UNC path se mount karte hain, maslan net use Z: \\st1.file.core.windows.net\docs, ya New-PSDrive se. Portal ka Connect button script bana deta hai. Azure Files iSCSI target nahi, AzCopy shares mount nahi kar sakta, aur FTP supported nahi.

D2-183.q: On-premises ya doosre region se Azure file shares mount karne ke liye kaun sa SMB version zaroori hai?
D2-183.exp: Azure region ke bahar se, on-premises samet, connections ko encryption ke sath SMB 3.x use karna hota hai taa ke data transit mein mehfooz rahe. SMB 1.0 supported nahi, aur SMB 2.x sirf usi region ke andar se kaam karta hai.

D2-184.q: Azure file share ko poora share ghalti se delete hone se kaise bachayen?
opts: File shares ke liye soft delete enable karein
Containers ke liye soft delete on karein
D2-184.exp: File share soft delete delete hue file share ko retention period tak rakhta hai, taa ke aap usay undelete kar sakein. Blob aur container soft delete Blob storage ko bachate hain, Azure Files ko nahi.

D2-185.q: Har file share par zyada se zyada kitne share snapshots ho sakte hain?
D2-185.exp: Har Azure file share par 200 tak share snapshots ho sakte hain. Rozana snapshots ke sath yeh chhe mahine se zyada cover karta hai; Azure Backup aap ke liye unhein manage aur expire karta hai.

D2-186.q: Ek user ne ek file delete kar di. Share snapshots mojood hain. User Windows par khud usay kaise restore kar sakta hai?
opts: File Explorer mein 'Previous Versions' tab use karein
File share par --undelete ke sath AzCopy chalayen
D2-186.exp: Share snapshots Windows File Explorer mein Properties → Previous Versions ke neeche nazar aate hain, is liye users khud file ki purani copy khol ya restore kar sakte hain. Share dobara banane ya Microsoft se rabte ki zaroorat nahi.

D2-187.q: Kya share snapshots poora storage account delete hone par aap ko bacha sakte hain?
opts: Nahi — snapshots usi account mein hote hain aur us ke sath delete ho jate hain
Haan — ZRS mein snapshots 14 din doosre zone mein rehte hain
D2-187.exp: Share snapshots share wale storage account ke andar hi store hote hain. Agar poora account delete ho to snapshots bhi sath chale jate hain. Account ko CanNotDelete lock se bachayen, aur Azure Backup use karein (jis ka vault-standard tier account ke bahar copies rakh sakta hai).

D2-188.q: Windows Server ko Azure Files se sync karne ke liye us par kya install hona chahiye?
opts: Azure File Sync agent, aur server Storage Sync Service mein registered ho
MARS agent, aur server Recovery Services vault mein registered ho
D2-188.exp: Azure Files se sync hone wale har Windows Server par Azure File Sync agent install hona chahiye aur woh Storage Sync Service mein registered hona chahiye. Sirf tab aap us ke folders server endpoints ke taur par add kar sakte hain. MARS agent Azure Backup ke liye hai, aur Azure Monitor Agent telemetry collect karta hai.

D2-189.q: Azure File Sync deploy karne ke steps tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: Cloud endpoint ke sath sync group banayen
Storage Sync Service deploy karein
Server par agent install kar ke server register karein
Sync group mein server endpoint add karein
D2-189.exp: Pehle Storage Sync Service deploy karein. Phir server par agent install kar ke usay us service mein register karein. Us ke baad Azure file share ko cloud endpoint bana kar sync group banayen. Aakhir mein server ka folder server endpoint ke taur par add karein. Server endpoint tabhi add ho sakta hai jab server registered ho aur sync group mojood ho.

D2-190.q: Ek sync group mein kitne cloud endpoints ho sakte hain?
D2-190.exp: Sync group bilkul ek Azure file share (us ka cloud endpoint) ko registered servers ke ek ya zyada folders (server endpoints) se sync karta hai. Doosra file share sync karne ke liye doosra sync group banayen.

D2-191.q: Kya ek registered server ke server endpoints kai sync groups mein ho sakte hain?
opts: Haan, jab tak paths overlap na hon
Nahi, har server ka ek sync group
D2-191.exp: Ek registered server kai sync groups ka hissa ho sakta hai, jab tak har server endpoint alag, overlap na karne wala path ho (maslan D:\Finance aur D:\HR). Agent sirf Windows Server par chalta hai, aur premium shares zaroori nahi.

D2-192.q: Ek branch office ko central Azure file share ka tez local access chahiye. Kaun sa hal?
opts: Local Windows Server par server endpoint ke sath Azure File Sync
Branch ke qareeb tareen region ke storage account tak object replication
D2-192.exp: Azure File Sync branch office ke Windows Server par install hota hai aur central Azure file share ko locally cache karta hai, is liye users LAN ki raftar se files kholte hain jab ke changes Azure se sync hote hain. Object replication blobs ke liye hai, GRS Azure regions ke darmiyan copy karta hai, aur Storage Explorer management tool hai.

D2-193.q: Cloud tiering mein kaun si policy yaqeeni banati hai ke local volume ka kam az kam 20% khali rahe?
D2-193.exp: Volume free space policy files ko Azure mein tier karti hai taa ke local volume ka kam az kam chuna gaya percentage (yahan 20%) khali rahe. Date policy un files ko tier karti hai jo makhsoos dinon se access nahi hui. Retention aur lifecycle policies File Sync settings nahi.

D2-194.q: Kaun se operating systems Azure File Sync agent chala sakte hain?
D2-194.exp: Azure File Sync agent sirf Windows Server ke supported versions par chalta hai. Linux, macOS aur Windows 10/11 desktop versions server endpoints nahi ban sakte, halan ke woh Azure file share ko seedha SMB par mount kar sakte hain.

D2-195.q: Azure Files ke bare mein Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: NFS shares ek sath Windows clients se SMB par access ho sakte hain
Azure file shares Azure VMs aur on-premises machines dono mount kar sakti hain
Share snapshots read-only hain
Premium file shares SSD par chalte hain
D2-195.exp: File share ek protocol use karta hai — NFS ya SMB — is liye NFS share SMB par access nahi ho sakta. Shares Azure VMs aur on-premises machines dono mount kar sakti hain. Share snapshots read-only hain. Premium file shares SSDs use karte hain.

D2-196.q: Bare block blobs ke liye AzCopy aur SDK kaun sa upload tareeqa use karte hain?
opts: Blocks parallel mein stage karein (Put Block) phir block list commit karein
1 TB tak ka ek hi PUT bhejein aur phir us ka MD5 hash verify karein
D2-196.exp: Bare block blobs alag alag blocks mein upload hote hain, aksar parallel mein (Put Block), aur phir Put Block List se tarteeb mein commit hote hain, jo blob banata hai. Is se uploads tez hote hain aur fail hue blocks dobara try ho sakte hain. Single PUT sirf chhote blobs ke liye hai, aur page writes page blobs ke liye.

D2-197.q: Kaun sa feature blob ki read-only, point-in-time copy deta hai jo aap manually lete hain?
D2-197.exp: Blob snapshot kisi waqt blob ki read-only copy hai jo aap zaroorat par khud banate hain. Versions har change par khud bante hain. Soft delete aur legal hold data bachate hain lekin point-in-time copies nahi banate.

D2-198.q: Partner ke liye Blob storage ka SFTP access chahiye. Kya enable hona chahiye?
opts: Local users ke sath hierarchical namespace aur SFTP support
Static website hosting aur SFTP wala custom domain
D2-198.exp: Blob storage ke liye SFTP ko hierarchical namespace (Data Lake Storage Gen2) enabled aur SFTP on chahiye. Partners local users ke taur par password ya SSH key se sign in karte hain, aur un ki permissions containers tak scoped hoti hain. Static websites, NFS aur anonymous access SFTP nahi dete.

D2-199.ctx: GPv2 LRS account st1 mein container 'reports': versioning on, blob soft delete 14 din, container soft delete 7 din, lifecycle: modification ke 90 din baad tierToArchive.
D2-199.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: 10 din pehle delete hua blob restore ho sakta hai
9 din pehle delete hua 'reports' container restore ho sakta hai
120 din purana, badla na gaya blob foran parha ja sakta hai
Blob overwrite karne se pichla content version ke taur par rehta hai
D2-199.exp: Blob soft delete delete hue blobs 14 din rakhta hai, is liye 10 din pehle delete hua blob restore ho sakta hai. Container soft delete sirf 7 din hai, is liye 9 din pehle delete hua container nahi. 90 din baghair changes ke blob archive mein aur offline hota hai. Versioning blob overwrite hone par pichla content rakhti hai.

D2-200.ctx: 3 branch offices ke on-premises file servers ko Azure mein data ki shared central copy, tez local reads aur chhoti local disks chahiye. Users on-premises AD se authenticate karte hain.
opts: Har branch server par cloud tiering ke sath Azure File Sync, ek Azure file share se sync
Blob storage, teen accounts ke darmiyan object replication ke sath, har branch ke liye ek
GRS ke sath teen alag storage accounts
D2-200.exp: Azure File Sync ek central Azure file share ko har branch ke servers se sync rakhta hai. Cloud tiering aksar use hone wali files chhoti local disks par rakhti hai aur baqi Azure mein tier karti hai, is liye local reads tez rehte hain. NTFS ACLs, aur is tarah on-premises AD permissions, baqi rehti hain. Blob replication, alag GRS accounts aur akela DFS-R yeh sab nahi kar sakte.

D2-241.q: Ek standard GPv2 account ZRS use karta hai. Naye blobs ka access pattern pehle se maloom nahi, aur aap chahte hain ke Azure har blob ko khud hot, cool aur cold ke darmiyan move kare, bina rules sambhale. Aap kya configure karenge?
opts: Har container ke liye last-access condition wali lifecycle policy
Account ki default access tier Smart
Account ki default access tier Cold
Cool tier wale account tak object replication
D2-241.exp: Smart tier blobs ko un ke istemal ke mutabiq khud hot, cool aur cold ke darmiyan move karta hai, aur kisi rule ki zaroorat nahi. Isay on karne ke liye account ki default access tier Smart set karein. Lifecycle policy bhi tier badal sakti hai, lekin rules aap ko likhne aur sambhalne parte hain. Replication data copy karti hai, tier nahi karti.

D2-242.q: Blob storage ke smart tier ke bare mein kaun se DO statements sahi hain?
opts: Is ke liye zone-redundant account (ZRS, GZRS ya RA-GZRS) chahiye
Yeh 180 din access na hone par blobs ko archive mein move karta hai
Smart tier ke cool hisse ka blob parhne se woh wapas hot mein aa jata hai
Yeh premium block blob accounts par kaam karta hai
D2-242.exp: Smart tier zone redundancy (ZRS, GZRS ya RA-GZRS) wale standard GPv2 accounts par milta hai. Blob 30 din access na hone par cool aur 90 din par cold mein jata hai, aur koi bhi access usay wapas hot mein le aata hai. Archive smart tier ka hissa nahi, aur premium accounts supported nahi.

D2-243.q: Account ki default access tier Smart hai. Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Lifecycle rule smart tier wale blobs delete kar sakta hai
Lifecycle rule smart tier wale blobs ko archive mein move kar sakta hai
Smart tier ka 50-KiB blob 30 din baad cool mein jata hai
Jis blob ki tier tabdeeli se pehle explicit set thi, woh smart tier mein chala jata hai
D2-243.exp: Lifecycle management smart tier ke blobs ko tier nahi kar sakti, lekin us ke delete actions lagu hote hain. 128 KiB se chhote objects hot mein rehte hain. Jin blobs ki explicit tier nahi thi woh default badalne par smart tier mein aate hain, jab ke explicit tier wale wahin rehte hain.

D2-244.q: Classic Azure file shares ke soft delete ke bare mein kaun se DO statements sahi hain?
opts: Yeh poore storage account ke liye configure hota hai
Yeh share se user ki delete ki hui ek file wapas lata hai
Retention period 1 se 365 din ho sakta hai
Is ke liye Recovery Services vault chahiye
D2-244.exp: File shares ka soft delete storage account level par set hota hai, 1 se 365 din ki retention ke sath (default 7). Yeh sirf poore share ke liye kaam karta hai: ek file wapas lane ke liye share snapshot ya Azure Files backup use karein. Soft delete ke liye vault ki zaroorat nahi.

D2-245.q: File shares ka soft delete on hai. User share se ek spreadsheet delete kar deta hai, lekin share maujood hai. Kaun sa feature file wapas la sakta hai?
opts: Deletion se pehle liya gaya share snapshot
Usi account par blobs ki versioning
D2-245.exp: Azure Files ka soft delete sirf poore shares ko bachata hai, is liye ek file delete hone par kaam nahi aata. Deletion se pehle liya gaya share snapshot (ya Azure Files backup) mein file maujood hoti hai, aur aap usay wapas copy kar sakte hain. Blob soft delete aur versioning file shares par lagu nahi.

D2-246.q: Account mein archive tier use hona hai aur app doosre region se kabhi bhi parh sake. Kaun si redundancy chunenge?
D2-246.exp: Archive ZRS, GZRS ya RA-GZRS accounts par supported nahi, is liye LRS, GRS aur RA-GRS bachte hain. Secondary se kabhi bhi parhne ke liye read-access option chahiye, is liye jawab RA-GRS.

D2-247.q: Ek account zone outage mein baghair failover chale, doosre region se parha ja sake, aur archive tier mein blobs rakhe. Aap team ko kya batayenge?
opts: RA-GZRS teenon zarooratein poori karta hai
RA-GRS teenon zarooratein poori karta hai
Koi ek account teenon zarooratein poori nahi karta
ZRS wale premium block blobs teenon zarooratein poori karte hain
D2-247.exp: RA-GZRS zone outage aur doosra region cover karta hai lekin archive support nahi karta. RA-GRS archive aur doosra region deta hai lekin zone outage nahi. Premium accounts mein na geo-redundancy hai na archive. Data do accounts mein baantna hoga, ya ek zaroorat chhorni hogi.

D2-248.q: Qanoonan data ek Azure region se bahar nahi ja sakta, lekin ek availability zone band hone par bhi account chalna chahiye. Kaun si redundancy?
D2-248.exp: ZRS ek hi region ke availability zones mein data synchronously copy karta hai, is liye zone outage mein chalta hai aur kuch region se bahar nahi jata. GRS aur GZRS doosre region mein copy karte hain, aur LRS zone outage se nahi bachata.

D2-249.q: Build servers temporary files likhte hain jo kabhi bhi dobara ban sakti hain. Kharcha sab se ahem hai. Kaun si redundancy?
D2-249.exp: LRS sab se sasta hai aur ek datacenter mein disk aur rack ki kharabi se bachata hai. Files dobara ban sakti hain, is liye zone ya geo copies ka paisa dene ka faida nahi.

D2-250.q: Aap GRS account ka unplanned customer-managed failover shuru karte hain. Mukammal hone ke baad kya sahi hai?
opts: Account GRS hai aur asal region naya secondary hai
Account naye primary region mein LRS hai
Account naye primary region mein ZRS hai
Account RA-GRS hai aur dono regions writes lete hain
D2-250.exp: Unplanned failover mein secondary primary banta hai, asal primary region ki copy delete hoti hai, aur account LRS ban jata hai, is liye dobara on karne tak geo-redundancy nahi. Kuch data ja sakta hai, kyunke replication asynchronous hai.

D2-251.q: GRS account ka primary region 10:30 par band hota hai. Account ka Last Sync Time 10:12 hai. Unplanned failover ke baad kaun si writes ja sakti hain?
opts: Pichle poore ghante se tamam writes
Koi nahi, kyunke GRS synchronous hai
D2-251.exp: Last Sync Time woh aakhri waqt hai jab tak primary par likha sab kuch secondary par bhi likha ja chuka tha. 10:12 ke baad ki writes shayad copy na hui hon, is liye ja sakti hain. GRS doosre region mein asynchronously copy karta hai.

D2-252.q: App ko block blobs ke liye bohat kam latency chahiye aur apne region ki zone outage mein chalna chahiye. Kaun sa account banayenge?
D2-252.exp: Premium block blob accounts kam latency ke liye SSD use karte hain aur sirf LRS aur ZRS support karte hain. ZRS zone outage cover karta hai. Premium geo-redundant nahi ho sakta, aur standard mein itni kam latency nahi.

D2-253.q: GZRS account mein Azure file share hai. Users aam halat mein secondary region se share parhna chahte hain. Aap kya jawab denge?
opts: Account RA-GZRS karein, jis se share parha ja sakega
Mumkin nahi: share wahan sirf failover ke baad parha jata hai
Share ko "-secondary" naam aur port 445 se mount karein
Secondary region par large file shares on karein
D2-253.exp: Azure Files LRS, ZRS, GRS aur GZRS support karta hai, read-access (RA) options nahi. Secondary copy sirf failover ke baad kaam aati hai. Doosri jagah parhne ke liye Azure File Sync ya doosra share use karein.

D2-254.q: Storage redundancy ke bare mein Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: RA-GRS se app baghair failover secondary parh sakti hai
ZRS poore region ke nuqsan se bachata hai
Premium file share account GRS use kar sakta hai
GZRS primary region mein zone-redundant copies rakhta hai
D2-254.exp: Read-access options har waqt secondary ka readable endpoint dete hain. ZRS ek region mein rehta hai, is liye region ki tabahi ka asar hota hai. Premium sirf LRS aur ZRS support karta hai. GZRS primary region mein zone-redundant copies aur paired region mein copy dono rakhta hai.

D2-255.q: Aap blob seedha archive mein upload karte hain aur 100 din baad delete. Istemal hui storage ke alawa kya paisa lagega?
opts: Kuch nahi, kyunke archive ka minimum nahi
D2-255.exp: Archive ka minimum 180 din hai. 100 din baad delete karne par baqi 80 din ka charge lagta hai. Delete karne ke liye rehydrate nahi karna parta. Cool ka minimum 30 aur cold ka 90 din hai.

D2-256.q: Scans mahine mein zyada se zyada ek dafa parhe jate hain, chand second mein khulne chahiye, aur 120 din rakhe jate hain. Kaun si tier sab se sasti hai?
D2-256.exp: Cold online hai, is liye blobs foran khulte hain, storage ki qeemat hot aur cool se kam hai, aur 120 din us ke 90 din ke minimum se zyada hain. Archive per GB sasta hai lekin rehydrate mein ghante lagte hain aur minimum 180 din hai.

D2-257.q: Partner ko 24 ghante ke liye ek blob parhna hai. Account key use nahi karni, aur access kam se kam ho. Aap kya denge?
opts: Blob service ka account SAS, read aur list permissions ke sath
Account par Storage Blob Data Reader
Us blob ka read permission wala user delegation SAS
Account ki access key 2, ek din ke liye
D2-257.exp: User delegation SAS account key ki jagah Entra ID credentials se signed hota hai, aur ek blob, read permission aur 24 ghante tak mehdood ho sakta hai. Account SAS account key se signed aur wasee hai, aur role aur key us se kahin zyada access dete hain.

D2-258.q: Branch file server ki disk bhar rahi hai. Users ka UNC path wahi rahe aur taza files tez khulein, aur baad ka kaam kam ho. Aap kya karenge?
opts: Har mahine AzCopy se purani files Blob storage mein copy karein
Server par Azure File Sync lagayen aur cloud tiering on karein
Har client ko internet par Azure file share se map karein
Server aur storage account ke darmiyan object replication lagayen
D2-258.exp: Azure File Sync server aur us ka UNC path rakhta hai, aur cloud tiering thandi files ki jagah pointers rakhta hai jab ke taza files local rehti hain. AzCopy baar baar ka kaam hai aur files hata deta hai, clients map karne se path badalta hai, aur object replication storage accounts ke darmiyan hoti hai.

D2-259.q: Azure Files ke identity-based access ke liye ek storage account kitne identity sources use kar sakta hai?
opts: Do, agar ek AD DS ho
D2-259.exp: Storage account Azure Files ke liye sirf ek identity source use kar sakta hai: AD DS, Microsoft Entra Domain Services ya Microsoft Entra Kerberos. Alag shares ko alag sources chahiye to unhein alag storage accounts mein rakhein.

D2-260.q: Company mein sirf cloud-only Microsoft Entra users hain, Active Directory nahi. Woh apni identity se SMB par Azure file share khol saken. Aap kya enable karenge?
opts: Har user ke liye account key authentication
D2-260.exp: Microsoft Entra Kerberos Azure public cloud mein cloud-only identities support karta hai, aise supported clients se jo Entra joined ya hybrid joined hon. AD DS ko synced on-premises identities chahiye. Keys aur SAS user ki pehchan nahi karte.

D2-261.q: Aap ne file share ke liye Microsoft Entra Kerberos on kiya. Sahi roles wale users phir bhi connect nahi hote. Ek Conditional Access policy tamam cloud apps ke liye MFA mangti hai. Aap kya karenge?
opts: Storage account ki Entra app ko MFA policy se exclude karein
Users ko storage account par Owner dein
Har client subnet ke NSG mein TCP port 88 internet ke liye kholein
Storage account par secure transfer band karein
D2-261.exp: Storage account Entra ID mein ek app ke taur par hota hai, aur Entra Kerberos se share mount karte waqt MFA supported nahi. Us app ko MFA mangne wali Conditional Access policies se exclude karein. Roles, ports aur secure transfer yahan wajah nahi.

D2-262.q: Aap ne 09:00 par provisioned v2 file share ki IOPS barhayi aur ab wapas kam karna chahte hain. Kya lagu hota hai?
opts: Foran kam kar sakte hain, jitni dafa chahein, baghair extra kharche
Aakhri izafe ke 24 ghante baad hi kam kar sakte hain
30 din baad hi kam kar sakte hain
Naye share ke baghair kam nahi kar sakte
D2-262.exp: Provisioned v2 model mein storage, IOPS aur throughput alag alag set hote hain. Value kabhi bhi barh sakti hai lekin aakhri izafe ke 24 ghante baad hi kam hoti hai. Naye file shares ke liye Microsoft provisioned v2 recommend karta hai.

D2-263.q: Disaster recovery drill mein GZRS account ko data khoye baghair fail over karna hai aur geo-redundancy rakhni hai. Dono regions theek hain. Aap kya use karenge?
opts: Redundancy LRS kar ke wapas badalna
D2-263.exp: Customer-managed planned failover endpoints badalne se pehle replication mukammal karta hai, is liye data ka nuqsan nahi hona chahiye, aur geo-redundancy rehti hai. Unplanned failover mein data ja sakta hai aur account LRS reh jata hai.

D2-264.q: GRS account ka primary region ghanton se band hai. Planned failover kyun use nahi ho sakta?
opts: Woh sirf premium accounts ke liye hai
Us ke liye dono regions available hone chahiye
Us ke liye GRS nahi, RA-GRS chahiye
Woh 24 ghante pehle mangna parta hai
D2-264.exp: Planned failover ko pehle primary se replication mukammal karni hoti hai, is liye dono regions available hone chahiye. Primary band ho to unplanned failover hai, jis mein taza writes ja sakti hain, ya region theek hone ka intezar.

D2-265.q: GZRS account ke planned customer-managed failover ke bare mein Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: Failover ke dauran clients account mein likh sakte hain
Fail back ke baad account phir GZRS hota hai
Unplanned failover ki tarah data ka nuqsan mutawaqqe hai
Azure Files clients ko shares dobara mount karne par sakte hain
D2-265.exp: Planned failover chalte waqt read aur write access band hota hai. Switch se pehle replication mukammal hoti hai, is liye data ka nuqsan mutawaqqe nahi, aur failback ke baad asal redundancy (GZRS) wapas aati hai. File share clients ko dobara mount karna par sakta hai.

D2-266.q: Storage account aur key vault Transition mode mein network security perimeter se jure hain. Security chahti hai ke jo public traffic kisi rule se allowed nahi woh block ho. Aap kya karenge?
opts: Dono resources ke tamam private endpoints delete karein
D2-266.exp: Transition mode default hai aur yeh samajhne ke liye hai ke kaun sa traffic hai, jab ke resource ke apne firewall rules chalte rehte hain. Enforced mode public traffic deny karta hai, siwaye perimeter ke andar ke traffic aur access rules ke. NSG subnets aur NICs par lagta hai, perimeter par nahi.

D2-267.q: Network security perimeter ka bunyadi maqsad kya hai?
opts: Ek virtual network ke subnets ke darmiyan traffic filter karna
PaaS resources ke group tak public network access control karna
VMs ko doosre VNet mein private IP dena
Do peered VNets ka traffic encrypt karna
D2-267.exp: Network security perimeter storage accounts aur key vaults jaise PaaS resources ke gird hadd hai: members aapas mein baat kar sakte hain, aur bahar se ya bahar ki taraf public access ke liye access rule chahiye. Subnets NSG se filter hote hain, aur private IPs private endpoints se milte hain.

D2-268.q: Storage account Enforced mode ke network security perimeter mein hai. Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: Private endpoint ke traffic ko inbound access rule chahiye
Usi perimeter ka doosra storage account baghair access rule pahunch mein hai
Inbound rules IP ranges ya subscriptions par ho sakte hain
Outbound rules FQDN par hote hain
D2-268.exp: Private endpoint ka traffic baghair access rules allowed hai, aur ek hi perimeter ke members baat kar sakte hain. Baqi public traffic ke liye inbound rules IP ranges ya subscriptions (ya service tags) par, aur outbound rules FQDN par hote hain.

D2-269.ctx: VNet1 ki VMs aur on-premises servers (site-to-site VPN se jure) ko storage account st1 tak private IP par pahunchna hai.
D2-269.q: Hal: Aap VMs ke subnet par Microsoft.Storage service endpoint on karte hain aur st1 mein VNet rule lagate hain. Kya yeh maqsad poora karta hai?
D2-269.exp: Service endpoint ke sath VMs st1 ka public endpoint hi use karti hain, aur on-premises servers isay use hi nahi kar sakte. Maqsad ko private IP chahiye, yani private endpoint.

D2-270.ctx: VNet1 ki VMs aur on-premises servers (site-to-site VPN se jure) ko storage account st1 tak private IP par pahunchna hai.
D2-270.q: Hal: Aap VNet1 mein st1 ka private endpoint banate hain, privatelink DNS zone ko VNet1 se link karte hain, aur zone ki on-premises DNS queries DNS Private Resolver ko forward karte hain. Kya yeh maqsad poora karta hai?
D2-270.exp: Private endpoint st1 ko VNet1 mein private IP deta hai jahan on-premises servers VPN se pahunchte hain. Linked zone VMs ke liye naam resolve karta hai, aur resolver on-premises servers ke liye, is liye dono private IP use karte hain.

D2-271.q: Storage account st1 ki networking settings dekhein. Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: SubnetA ki VM (Microsoft.Storage service endpoint ke sath) st1 tak pahunch sakti hai
SubnetB ki VM st1 tak pahunch sakti hai
Public IP 203.0.113.25 wala laptop st1 tak pahunch sakta hai
Azure Backup ko firewall rokta hai
D2-271.exp: SubnetA ka VNet rule aur service endpoint hai. SubnetB ka rule nahi, is liye us ki VMs block hain. 203.0.113.25 allowed range 203.0.113.0/24 mein hai. Trusted services exception Azure Backup jaisi services ko guzarne deta hai. Caller ko authorization phir bhi chahiye.

D2-272.ctx: VNet1 ki VMs aur on-premises servers (site-to-site VPN se jure) ko storage account st1 tak private IP par pahunchna hai.
D2-272.q: Hal: Aap st1 ka firewall on karte hain aur VMs aur on-premises router ke public IP addresses us ke IP rules mein dalte hain. Kya yeh maqsad poora karta hai?
D2-272.exp: IP rules sirf tay karte hain ke kaun se public addresses st1 ka public endpoint use karein. Traffic phir bhi public IP par jata hai, aur maqsad mein private IP mangi gayi hai. DNS ke sath private endpoint yeh karta hai.
